records.title: 来给CIL 端。来个TUI
records.body: 不要学Zcode。不要学Zcode。来个TUI端。开发大部分都是远程。Linux才是ai的主战场。别学Zcode做远程连接。能直接原生命令行用是最好的。你把TUI做好了。再说做app这些。

comments.body:
这个诉求其实可以拆成两件事：runtime 要贴着仓库跑，操作界面不一定也要贴着 runtime。TUI 对纯 SSH 场景确实最顺，但稳定的 headless/protocol 边界也很重要，这样 TUI、GUI、手机控制端不用各造一套 Agent 内核。

rc.6 自带文档里已经有 `dsh --profile headless "job"`，会运行一个持久化 session、打印最终答案再退出；现在缺的是交互式 TUI 和可持续订阅的结构化事件流。

我在维护 BitFun。我们处理远程开发时，会让文件、终端、搜索和 Agent execution 留在 SSH host，GUI 只是控制面；另外还有 self-hosted relay，可以从手机或另一台设备接管 session。这个经验看下来，TUI 和远程 GUI 不是二选一，关键是 runtime 边界别绑死在某个界面上。如果 DSH 把 headless 的 streaming、permission、resume 稳住，两边都能复用。源码：https://github.com/GCWing/BitFun
Yep, looking for TUI/CLI version for headless platforms and small footprint

现在这条路已经能直接用了：社区的 `@deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui` 提供纯终端界面，SSH 到 Linux 主机后即可使用，不需要把 Agent 内核另写一遍。

如果还希望把 Pi 生态的 MCP、子代理等插件带进这个 TUI，可以按 DSH 的标准插件方式安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add pi2dsh
```

我在 stock npm DSH + stock dsh-TUI 上跑过双 Agent、真实模型回合和 Pi 插件管理界面；没有 fork TUI 或 DSH。项目和完整复现步骤：https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh#walkthrough-advanced-mcp-in-your-terminal

records.title: [Idea] dsh-memory：跨会话长期记忆插件（补上 memory 能力缺口）
records.body:
看到 #14 在求 memory 能力，也确认了 `packages/` 里目前没有独立的 memory 包。想提一个作为**社区插件**落地的方案，严格走「everything is a plugin」的 seam 设计。

## 定位

`dsh-memory`：给 agent 提供**跨会话长期记忆**。当前 agent 的上下文（session log、compaction、spill）都是「单会话内」的，会话结束后知识就没了；memory 补上「跨会话持久」这一环。

## 按 capability seam 三角色拆

**Service Definition** — `ctx.memory`：

```ts
interface MemoryService {
  remember(fact: string, opts?: { tags?: string[]; source?: string }): Promise<MemoryEntry>
  recall(query: string, opts?: { limit?: number }): Promise<MemoryEntry[]>
  forget(id: MemoryId): Promise<void>
}
```

**Service Provider** — 默认本地 JSONL store（存 Harness home 下），检索用轻量关键词 + 时间衰减排序，零重依赖；预留可换成向量库 / 远程的 provider。

**Consumer**（两处）：
- 模型可见工具 `memory_add` / `memory_search`，注册到 `ctx.tools`，schema 自动进入 prompt 组装；
- 自动注入：在 `agent/pre-step` 或 `agent.inject()` 处，按当前输入召回最相关的前 N 条，作为一段紧凑上下文注入。

## 符合仓库不变量

- 「model-visible ⟺ logged」：注入的记忆必须能从 session log 重建——把注入动作写成新的 session event，而不是在 prompt 里拼接不可追溯的文本。
- 纯插件、不动 agent-loop：所有挂点都是已文档化的扩展点（`ctx.tools` / `agent/*` / session event）。

## 为什么值得做

- 社区有直接需求（#14）；
- 官方仓库暂无 memory 包，缺口明确；
- 当前主流 agent harness 都在补 memory 能力，这是生态里能立刻产生差异化的一块。

## 落地方式

作为独立仓库（加 `dsh-plugin` topic）先出 MVP：本地 JSONL provider + 两个工具 + 自动注入；后续按反馈换 provider。

comments.body:
这个 capability seam 方向已经验证可以落地。我们实现了两个彼此独立的社区插件，和这里的 `remember / recall / forget` 架构高度重合，但在治理和 Prompt 策略上做了不同选择。

[`mindspace-dsh-session-memory`](https://github.com/Spirtxiaoqi7/mindspace-dsh-session-memory) 负责小而高优先级的结构化长期记忆：用户画像、分类偏好、AI 要求、关系/工作使命和扮演预设。模型通过显式工具追加、合并或覆盖冲突事实；用户能直接查看、编辑，活动有 append/merge/replace/skip 审计。存储按 Session 隔离，避免不同 Agent/窗口互相串记忆。

[`mindspace-dsh-local-rag`](https://github.com/Spirtxiaoqi7/mindspace-dsh-local-rag) 负责可搜索的大规模层：全局上传知识库 + 按会话隔离的 DSH 原生压缩摘要。它只在 `compaction/end` 提交后摄取并去重摘要，不把每轮原始对话写入库；模型通过标准 `search_local_memory` 工具自主检索。

和本提案最重要的差异是：我们刻意不做“每轮自动召回并注入 Prompt”。当前上下文永远优先，只有模型判断现有信息不足时才调用检索；召回结果标记为不可信参考资料，并保留来源、时间和轮次。这减少 Token 常驻成本，也避免旧记忆覆盖当前指令。

两套插件都不修改 agent-loop，可独立安装/卸载。实现与组合部署说明见 [#1109](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1109)，可以作为 `ctx.memory` 上游接口设计的一个实际运行参考。

这个缺口现在还有一条已经跑通的路线：直接复用 Pi 生态现成的长期记忆插件，而不用先为 DSH 重写一套。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh@0.10.0
dsh plugin --profile web add pi-hermes-memory
```

`pi-hermes-memory` 通过 pi2dsh 的 Host ABI 在 DSH 中注册自己的记忆工具；我们已经做过真实跨进程验证：一个 DSH 进程写入，退出后由另一个新进程检索，能够召回同一条记忆。安装两个 npm 包即可，不改 DSH agent-loop，也不需要把 memory 私有逻辑塞进 Harness core。

这和本帖的 capability seam 并不冲突：官方/社区仍可以定义 DSH 原生 `ctx.memory` 服务；pi2dsh 提供的是另一条生态复用路径，让已有 Pi memory 实现今天就能成为 DSH 插件。项目与验证范围： https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh

https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1728     可以自己提PR收录    。记得互相赞赏。


你这个挺好。

records.title: [Feature Request] Use OpenAI Codex OAuth as a primary LLM provider
records.body:
## Summary

Please support `openai-codex` (ChatGPT Plus/Pro OAuth) as a **primary LLM provider** in DeepSeek Harness, so users can select Codex models on the Models page instead of only invoking Codex as a subagent.

Tested against:

- npm: `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6`
- repository: `47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a`
- pi-ai: `@earendil-works/pi-ai ^0.82.1`

## Current implementation evidence

Most provider-side building blocks already exist:

1. pi-ai ships the `openai-codex` provider, its model catalog, the `openai-codex-responses` protocol, browser/device-code OAuth, refresh logic, and `CredentialStore` integration.
2. DSH `llm-pi-ai` already materializes pi-ai catalog providers.
3. DSH intentionally withholds OAuth-only catalog routes from the configurable-provider directory because `PiAiAdapter` creates `Models` without a credential store and exposes only `resolveApiKey`.
4. The repository already ships `dsh-subagent-codex`, which delegates to the host `codex app-server` and reuses native Codex authentication, but this does not make Codex available as the parent session model.

The relevant code is in:

- `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/catalog.ts` (`catalogProviderTakesApiKey` and the OAuth-only exclusion rationale)
- `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/adapter.ts` (`createModels()` without `CredentialStore`)
- `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/index.ts` (configurable-provider directory filtering)
- `packages/subagent/subagent-codex/` (working native-Codex delegation path)

## Expected behavior

- The Models page offers **OpenAI Codex**.
- A user can sign in with their own ChatGPT/Codex account through browser or device-code OAuth.
- The OAuth credential is persisted under DSH ownership with owner-only permissions and refreshed under a serialized store lock.
- Codex models can be selected as the default parent-session model.
- Sign-out removes only the DSH-owned credential.

## Security boundary

DSH should use its own OAuth login and credential store. It should **not read, copy, refresh, or overwrite `~/.codex/auth.json`**, because sharing a rotating refresh token between Codex CLI and DSH can invalidate one client and couples DSH to another products private file format.

## Suggested implementation

1. Add a structured OAuth credential store owned by DSH (or a small adapter from a secure DSH credential service to pi-ai `CredentialStore`).
2. Construct each immutable pi-ai `Models` snapshot with that shared store.
3. Add host RPC operations for auth status, login, cancellation, and logout; bridge pi-ai `AuthInteraction` events to the Web UI.
4. Offer OAuth-only providers when the runtime has a persistent store and login surface.
5. Add keyless tests for store serialization, refresh persistence, cancellation, redaction, and provider-directory visibility; keep real OAuth as an opt-in e2e.

Because the contribution guide currently says external pull requests are not accepted, would the maintainers prefer this as a first-party capability, or as an ecosystem `dsh-plugin`? I can prepare a focused implementation after the intended ownership boundary is confirmed.

comments.body:
## Local protocol proof

I also ran a transient, in-memory proof against the installed pi-ai provider. No credential value was printed or written, and no repository file was changed.

1. Register `openaiCodexProvider()` in `createModels({ credentials })`.
2. Supply a valid OAuth credential through an in-memory `CredentialStore`.
3. Call `completeSimple()` with `openai-codex / gpt-5.6-terra`.

Result:

```json
{"provider":"openai-codex","model":"gpt-5.6-terra","stopReason":"stop","text":"DSH_CODEX_OK"}
```

This confirms that the provider protocol and current model catalog work end to end. The missing product work is the DSH-owned OAuth credential lifecycle and login surface described above, not the model transport itself.

replies.body: hi, 我已经实现一个简单的实现

comments.body: Looks at this Plugin: https://github.com/Yan-Zero/dsh-codex

这个需求现在已经有可直接安装的通用实现：[pi2dsh](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh)。它不是调用 Codex 子代理，而是让 OpenAI Codex OAuth token 进入 Harness 原生 LLM 路由，作为父会话主模型使用。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh@0.11.0
```

Pi 的四条官方 OAuth 流（OpenAI Codex、Anthropic、GitHub Copilot、Kimi Code）已内置，不需要再安装账号包。在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中配置：

```yaml
- id: credentials
  name: pi2dsh/credentials-oauth

- id: llm-pi-ai
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai"
  config:
    providers:
      openai-codex:
        apiKeyEnv: PI2DSH_OAUTH_OPENAI_CODEX
        models:
          - id: gpt-5.6-luna
```

重启 Web 后执行：

```text
/login openai-codex
```

授权流程使用 PKCE + localhost callback，无头环境可走 device code；凭证以 owner-only 权限独立落盘，刷新采用按 provider 串行的双检锁轮换。`pi2dsh/credentials-oauth` 是标准 `dsh-credentials` provider，每次模型请求都会重新解析并刷新引用，token 不进入模型设置。

这条链路已经用真实 ChatGPT Pro 账号完整验证：浏览器授权 → token 落盘 → credentials provider → 官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` route → DSH 原生 `ctx.llm.stream()` → Codex 模型真实回复。也就是说已经覆盖了本帖“作为 primary LLM provider”这一点，不需要修改 Harness 源码或手工生成 bundle。

records.title: 图片粘贴之后，选择了支持多模态的llm，但是还是提示 模型不支持图片
records.body: 情况为： 环境为：mac air m4 模型配置为：

comments.body:
配置文件添加input
比如
         models: [ { id: 1234, name: 1234, input: [ 'text', 'image' ] } ]

已定位根因：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek`（所有 OpenAI 兼容网关的默认适配器路径）的 `modelInfo()` 对**目录中的每一个模型**（无论是否视觉模型）都返回硬编码的 `inputModalities: ["text"]`（`lib/index.js` L442）。图片受理门控（`dsh-host-apiproxy` `… 完整源码定位与修复方案见 https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/911 。

选了视觉模型仍报「模型不支持图片」，多半是门控看适配器的 `inputModalities`，不是模型真不能看。#911 写了：`llm-deepseek` 硬编码只有 text。

[dsh-plugin-multimodal](https://github.com/shinjiyu/dsh-plugin-multimodal) 让 Web 先收图。主模型本身收图就原样转发；纯文本主模型走 sidecar 转写。不是 vision_* 工具箱。

```
dsh plugin --profile web add github:shinjiyu/dsh-plugin-multimodal
```

重启 `dsh web`。

[#911](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/911) · [#1709](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1709)

这个场景可以绕开 `llm-deepseek` 把 `inputModalities` 固定成 text 的门控：pi2dsh 会给文本 route 自动注册 `<route>-vision` 伴生路由，由视觉插件先读图，再把分析注入原模型。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh@0.10.0
dsh plugin --profile web add @kassing/pi-vision

export VISION_BRIDGE_BASE_URL=https://openrouter.ai/api/v1
export VISION_BRIDGE_MODEL=qwen/qwen2.5-vl-72b-instruct
export VISION_BRIDGE_API_KEY=$OPENROUTER_API_KEY
```

重启后在模型选择器选 **DeepSeek + Vision Bridge** 分组中的同名主模型，再粘贴图片。伴生 route 对 Web 正确声明 image input；`@kassing/pi-vision` 调你配置的视觉端点分析像素；随后图片块被转成文本分析再交给原模型，所以不会把不支持的 image block 硬塞进文本 adapter。

这条链路已在真实 DSH Web 用不同纯色图片做过闭环验证。复现配置和测试图： https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/tree/main/examples/vision-bridge

= io.StringIO() try: exec(code, safe_globals) output = sys.stdout.getvalue() error = sys.stderr.getvalue() except Exception: output = "" error = traceback.format_exc() finally: sys.stdout = old_stdout sys.stderr = old_stderr return json5.dumps({ "output": output, "error": error }, ensure_ascii=False) # ------------------------------------------------------------ # Tools definition # ------------------------------------------------------------ tools = [ { "type": "function", "function": { "name": "run_python_code", "description": "Execute Python code and return its output.", "parameters": { "type": "object", "properties": { "code": { "type": "string", "description": "The Python code to be executed", } }, "required": ["code"] }, } }, ] tools_map = { "run_python_code": tool_run_python_code } # ------------------------------------------------------------ # Agent runner (unchanged core logic) # ------------------------------------------------------------ def run_agent(client, messages, tools, tools_map): while True: stream = client.chat.completions.create( model=DEEPSEEK_MODEL, stream=True, messages=messages, tools=tools, tool_choice="auto", extra_body={ "thinking": {"type": "enabled"}, "reasoning_effort": "max" } ) reasoning_chunks = [] content_chunks = [] tool_calls_dict = {} in_reasoning = False in_response = False for chunk in stream: delta = chunk.choices[0].delta finish_reason = chunk.choices[0].finish_reason if hasattr(delta, 'reasoning_content') and delta.reasoning_content: if not in_reasoning: print("[reasoning]", flush=True) in_reasoning = True print(delta.reasoning_content, end='', flush=True) reasoning_chunks.append(delta.reasoning_content) if hasattr(delta, 'content') and delta.content: if in_reasoning: print("\n[/reasoning]", flush=True) in_reasoning = False if not in_response: print("[response]", flush=True) in_response = True print(delta.content, end='', flush=True) content_chunks.append(delta.content) if hasattr(delta, 'tool_calls') and delta.tool_calls is not None: for tc_delta in delta.tool_calls: idx = tc_delta.index if idx not in tool_calls_dict: tool_calls_dict[idx] = { 'id': None, 'name': None, 'arguments_chunks': [] } if tc_delta.id: tool_calls_dict[idx]['id'] = tc_delta.id if tc_delta.function: if tc_delta.function.name: tool_calls_dict[idx]['name'] = tc_delta.function.name if tc_delta.function.arguments: tool_calls_dict[idx]['arguments_chunks'].append( tc_delta.function.arguments ) if finish_reason is not None: break if in_reasoning: print("\n[/reasoning]", flush=True) if in_response: print("\n[/response]", flush=True) reasoning_content = ''.join(reasoning_chunks) if reasoning_chunks else None content = ''.join(content_chunks) if content_chunks else None tool_calls = None if tool_calls_dict: tool_calls = [] for idx in sorted(tool_calls_dict.keys()): tc = tool_calls_dict[idx] tool_calls.append({ 'id': tc['id'], 'type': 'function', 'function': { 'name': tc['name'], 'arguments': ''.join(tc['arguments_chunks']) } }) messages.append({ "role": "assistant", "reasoning_content": reasoning_content, "content": content, "tool_calls": tool_calls }) if tool_calls is None: break print("[tools]") for tool in tool_calls: function_name = tool['function']['name'] tool_function = tools_map[function_name] tool_result = tool_function(**json5.loads(tool['function']['arguments'])) print(f"[{function_name}]\n{tool_result}\n[/{function_name}]") messages.append({ "role": "tool", "tool_call_id": tool['id'], "content": tool_result, }) print("[/tools]") # ------------------------------------------------------------ # Helper: Remove last assistant reply (and subsequent tool messages) # ------------------------------------------------------------ def remove_last_assistant_reply(messages): """ Remove the last assistant message and all subsequent tool messages from the messages list. Returns True if something was removed, False otherwise. """ # Find the index of the last user message last_user_idx = None for i in range(len(messages) - 1, -1, -1): if messages[i].get('role') == 'user': last_user_idx = i break if last_user_idx is None: # No user message found, nothing to regenerate print("[regenerate] No user message found; nothing to regenerate.") return False # Check if there is at least one assistant message after the last user message has_assistant_after = False for i in range(last_user_idx + 1, len(messages)): if messages[i].get('role') == 'assistant': has_assistant_after = True break if not has_assistant_after: print("[regenerate] No assistant reply after the last user message; nothing to regenerate.") return False # Truncate: keep everything up to and including the last user message removed_count = len(messages) - (last_user_idx + 1) del messages[last_user_idx + 1:] print(f"[regenerate] Removed {removed_count} message(s) (assistant reply + any tool results).") print("[regenerate] Ready to regenerate the last reply.") return True # ------------------------------------------------------------ # JSON session file helpers # ------------------------------------------------------------ def load_messages_from_json(filepath): """Load messages from a JSON file. Returns list of messages.""" if not os.path.exists(filepath): print(f"[Warning] File not found: {filepath}. Starting a new session.") return None try: with open(filepath, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f: data = json.load(f) # Support both a list of messages or a dict with a "messages" key if isinstance(data, list): messages = data elif isinstance(data, dict) and "messages" in data: messages = data["messages"] else: print(f"[Warning] Unrecognized format in {filepath}. Starting a new session.") return None print(f"[Loaded {len(messages)} messages from {filepath}]") return messages except (json.JSONDecodeError, IOError) as e: print(f"[Error] Failed to load {filepath}: {e}. Starting a new session.") return None def save_messages_to_json(filepath, messages): """Save messages to a JSON file.""" try: with open(filepath, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f: json.dump(messages, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) # Silently save; we can print a message if needed except IOError as e: print(f"[Error] Failed to save session to {filepath}: {e}") def generate_timestamp_filename(): """Generate a filename based on the current timestamp.""" timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S") return f"ds-agent-session-{timestamp}.json" # ------------------------------------------------------------ # prompt_toolkit setup # ------------------------------------------------------------ # Custom key bindings: Enter submits only when pressed with Alt; # plain Enter inserts a newline (multi-line mode). bindings = KeyBindings() @bindings.add('enter') def handle_enter(event): """Insert a newline on plain Enter (multi-line).""" event.current_buffer.insert_text('\n') @bindings.add('escape', 'enter') def handle_escape_enter(event): """Submit on Esc + Enter.""" event.current_buffer.validate_and_handle() @bindings.add('c-d') def handle_ctrl_d(event): """Exit on Ctrl+D if the input buffer is empty.""" buffer = event.current_buffer if buffer.text.strip() == '': event.app.exit(result=None) else: # If there's text, delete forward (default behavior fallback) buffer.delete() # Style for the prompt style = Style.from_dict({ 'prompt': 'ansicyan bold', 'toolbar': 'bg:#333333 #ffffff', 'separator': '#666666', }) def get_toolbar(): """Return the bottom toolbar text.""" return HTML( ' Multi-line mode | ' 'Enter = newline | ' 'Esc+Enter = submit | ' 'Ctrl+D = quit (empty input) | ' '/regen = regenerate last | ' '/cont = continue | ' '/help = help' ) # Create the PromptSession with history session = PromptSession( lexer=PygmentsLexer(PythonLexer), # syntax highlighting for Python style=style, key_bindings=bindings, multiline=True, bottom_toolbar=get_toolbar, history=None, # you can pass a FileHistory object for persistence ) # ------------------------------------------------------------ # Client initialization # ------------------------------------------------------------ client = OpenAI( api_key=DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, base_url="https://api.deepseek.com", ) # ------------------------------------------------------------ # Main loop # ------------------------------------------------------------ if __name__ == "__main__": parser = argparse.ArgumentParser( description="DeepSeek Agent with prompt_toolkit – multi-line interactive chat" ) parser.add_argument( "json_file", nargs="?", default=None, help="Path to a JSON message record file. If not provided, a new file " "with a timestamp is created automatically." ) parser.add_argument( "--new", "-n", action="store_true", help="Start a fresh session even if the JSON file exists (ignores existing messages)." ) args = parser.parse_args() # Determine the JSON file path if args.json_file: json_filepath = args.json_file else: json_filepath = generate_timestamp_filename() print(f"[No JSON file provided. Creating new session file: {json_filepath}]") # Load or initialize messages messages = None if args.new: print("[Starting a brand-new session (--new flag)]") messages = [{'role': 'system', 'content': 'You are a helpful assistant.'}] elif args.json_file and os.path.exists(args.json_file): loaded = load_messages_from_json(json_filepath) if loaded is not None: messages = loaded # Ensure the system message exists; if not, prepend one if not any(m.get('role') == 'system' for m in messages): messages.insert(0, {'role': 'system', 'content': 'You are a helpful assistant.'}) else: messages = [{'role': 'system', 'content': 'You are a helpful assistant.'}] else: messages = [{'role': 'system', 'content': 'You are a helpful assistant.'}] # Save the initial (or loaded) state save_messages_to_json(json_filepath, messages) print("=" * 60) print(" DeepSeek Agent – Multi-line Prompt ") print("=" * 60) print(f" Session file: {json_filepath}") print(" Type your message. Use Esc+Enter to send, Ctrl+D to exit.") print(" Commands:") print(" /regen – delete last assistant reply and regenerate it") print(" /cont – continue generating (submit conversation as-is)") print(" /help – show this help") print() while IS_AGENT_RUNNING: try: user_input = session.prompt( HTML('User> '), multiline=True, ) except KeyboardInterrupt: # Ctrl+C pressed print("\n[Interrupted]") continue except EOFError: # Ctrl+D on empty input → exit print("\n[Exiting]") break if user_input is None: break user_input = user_input.strip() if not user_input: continue if user_input.lower() in ("quit", "exit"): IS_AGENT_RUNNING = False continue # --- Command handling --- if user_input.startswith('/'): cmd = user_input[1:].strip().lower() if cmd in ('regen', 'regenerate'): # Regenerate the last assistant reply if remove_last_assistant_reply(messages): # Now run the agent again with the truncated messages run_agent(client, messages, tools, tools_map) save_messages_to_json(json_filepath, messages) else: # Nothing to regenerate; maybe just run the agent (treat as /cont) print("[regenerate] No reply to regenerate. Treating as /cont (continue).") run_agent(client, messages, tools, tools_map) save_messages_to_json(json_filepath, messages) continue elif cmd in ('cont', 'continue'): # Continue generating: submit the conversation as-is print("[continue] Submitting conversation to model for continuation...") run_agent(client, messages, tools, tools_map) save_messages_to_json(json_filepath, messages) continue elif cmd in ('help', '?'): print() print(" Available commands:") print(" /regen – delete last assistant reply and regenerate it") print(" /cont – continue generating (submit conversation as-is)") print(" /help – show this help") print(" quit/exit – exit the program") print() continue else: print(f"[Unknown command: /{cmd}. Type /help for available commands.]") continue # Normal user message: append and run agent messages.append({'role': 'user', 'content': user_input}) run_agent(client, messages, tools, tools_map) # Save after each complete turn (user + assistant + possible tool calls) save_messages_to_json(json_filepath, messages) print("Goodbye!") ```
我在用 Rust 重写 harness：deepseek-harness-rust，分层 crates（session log / turn-step loop / DeepSeek SSE adapter），CLI 可以在这个底子上出，headless 跑起来很轻。github.com/bobleer/deepseek-harness-rust，MIT，欢迎共建。
等官方吧，你们这么着急
顶上去

补充一个当前可用的方案：headless profile 就是"命令行形态"——`dsh --profile headless "任务"` 适合脚本/CI（打印结果退出、非零码即失败）。我们已经实测用它在 CI 场景跑数据任务、代码重构（见 dsh-handbook https://github.com/Electricitysheep/dsh-handbook 第 2/5 章，含真实耗时数据）。

交互式 CLI/TUI 目前需要插件（官方未内置）——这确实是个缺口，支持官方早日补上。
https://github.com/gxinxing/deepseek-harness-tui 看看

低配 VPS / 纯 SSH 的场景现在可以走 `@deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui`，不用启动 Web 界面。想把 Pi 生态插件一并带进 TUI，再安装 `pi2dsh`：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add pi2dsh
```

我们用 npm 原版 DSH、原版 dsh-TUI 跑过真实模型、两个独立 Agent 以及插件的命令和工具链；没有另造 Agent loop。步骤和证据：https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh#walkthrough-advanced-mcp-in-your-terminal

records.title: 支持「主模型 + 通用辅助模型槽位」体系（对标 Hermes），识图不再强制单向切换模型
records.body:
支持「主模型 + 通用辅助模型槽位」体系（对标 Hermes Agent）：主模型保持推理角色，图片由可独立配置的辅助视觉模型消化；会话标题、上下文压缩等侧任务可单独指定模型；含图会话可切回纯文本模型、临时切换不再静默改写全局默认。

<details>
<summary>背景与细节</summary>

### 背景：Hermes Agent 的辅助模型体系

[Hermes Agent](https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs/zh-Hans/user-guide/configuring-models) 定义两类模型槽位：主模型（思考）+ 辅助模型（侧任务），共 11 个任务槽：**Vision（图片分析）、Title Gen（标题生成）、Compression（上下文压缩）、Approval（审批评分）、Web Extract（网页提取）、Skills Hub（技能搜索）、MCP（工具路由）、Triage Specifier、Kanban Decomposer、Profile Describer、Curator**。每个槽位默认 `auto`（= 主模型），可独立覆盖为任意 provider/model，配置写 `auxiliary.<task>`；auto 不可用/失败时沿任务级 fallback 链 → 主 fallback 链 → 内置发现链降级。

### DSH 现状（代码定位）

- 单一模型选择：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent` `installModelSelection`（所有请求钉死在唯一 selection）；
- 全局默认：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-default-model`（settings `agent-default-model`，仅 provider/model/reasoningEffort）；
- 切模型图片守卫 + 静默落默认：`dsh-host-apiproxy` `selectModel`（含图会话禁止切回纯文本模型；每次切换都调用 `saveDefaultModelSelection`）；
- 发图拒绝：`dsh-host-apiproxy` `prompt` → `MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES`；
- 能力探测已具备：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` `resolveModelInfo().inputModalities`；
- **已有雏形（2/3 槽位已存在）**：
  - 会话标题：`dsh-session-title-llm` 已支持独立 `provider` + `model` override；
  - 上下文压缩：`dsh-compaction-basic` 已支持 `summarizationProvider`/`summarizationModel` + 按主模型精确路由的 `modelPolicies`；
  - 说明 DSH 只缺"统一槽位机制 + Vision 槽"，而非从零造。

### 需求拆解

- **通用机制**：辅助槽位默认 `auto`（沿用主模型）；每个槽位可独立指定 provider/model（可选 reasoningEffort）；auto 失败可沿 fallback 链降级；设置页统一「主模型 / 辅助模型」入口（对标 Hermes Models 页，支持"全部设为 auto"一键重置）。
- **槽位 1 · Vision（重点）**：主模型不支持 image 输入时，图片由辅助视觉模型转译/分析后注入对话（或该轮由视觉模型整轮代理），主模型不换；由此含图会话可切回纯文本主模型，解除"单向门"。
- **槽位 2 · Title Gen**：收编现有 `dsh-session-title-llm` override 为统一槽位。
- **槽位 3 · Compression**：收编现有 `compaction-basic` summarization 配置为统一槽位。

- 验收条件：
  - 设置页可独立配置各辅助槽位（provider + model，默认 `auto`）并持久化；
  - 主模型不支持图片时，发送带图消息不再被拒，图片由辅助视觉模型分析后主模型正常回复；
  - 含图会话允许切回不支持图片的纯文本模型（现状 `selectModel` 拒绝：`does not accept image input, but this session already contains images`）；
  - 模型切换默认仅影响当前会话，不再自动改写全局默认；显式「设为默认」才落盘；
  - `auto` 且主模型本身支持图片时，图片直接走主模型（行为与现状一致）；
  - 标题生成、上下文压缩可独立于主模型指定模型。

- 用户或模型可见变化：
  - 用户：识图不再需要手动切换多模态模型；模型切换可逆；全局默认不被临时操作污染；侧任务可省 token（如压缩用快模型）；
  - 模型：主模型始终为推理模型，图片信息以视觉模型转录文本注入（或按实现选择整轮代理）。

- 测试证据：
  - 纯文本主模型 + 配置视觉辅助模型 → 发图 → 主模型回复正确体现图片信息；
  - 上述会话切回纯文本主模型成功、无 `model-unavailable`；
  - 未勾选「设为默认」时 `agent-default-model` settings 未被改写；
  - `auto` + 多模态主模型 → 发图直接走主模型，调用日志无辅助模型调用；
  - 标题/压缩独立配置生效、`auto` 回落主模型正常。

- 参考实现：
  - Hermes Agent 模型配置文档：https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs/zh-Hans/user-guide/configuring-models
  - Hermes 配置结构（`auxiliary.<task>`）：https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent
  - DSH 相关包：`dsh-agent` / `dsh-agent-default-model` / `dsh-host-apiproxy` / `dsh-llm` / `dsh-session-title-llm` / `dsh-compaction-basic`

</details>

comments.body:
这个需求里“主模型 + 辅助视觉模型、含图历史继续交给文本主模型”这部分，现在已经有一条可直接安装的实现：[@kassing/pi-vision](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@kassing/pi-vision) 经 [pi2dsh](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh) 跑在 DSH 上。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh@0.11.0
dsh plugin --profile web add @kassing/pi-vision

export VISION_BRIDGE_BASE_URL=https://openrouter.ai/api/v1
export VISION_BRIDGE_MODEL=qwen/qwen2.5-vl-72b-instruct
export VISION_BRIDGE_API_KEY=$OPENROUTER_API_KEY
```

重启 `dsh web` 后，模型选择器会为文本路由自动出现 **“DeepSeek + Vision Bridge”** 伴生分组。用户直接粘贴图片即可：图片先由配置的视觉模型分析，分析结果作为 DSH 原生上下文注入交给原来的 DeepSeek 文本模型；真正发给文本模型前，图片块会被替换成文本引导，因此含图会话不会再把后续文本模型卡在 `MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES` 上。

这不是只做了 schema 声明：我们已经在真实 DSH Web 会话里用不同纯色图片做过闭环，视觉侧注入分析，DeepSeek 文本主模型零图片输入、零工具调用直接答对颜色。可复现实例和测试图在：[examples/vision-bridge](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/tree/main/examples/vision-bridge)。

这个需求很实际。等官方支持之外，现在有插件方案能解：

- **dsh-vision-toolkit** —— 给纯文本模型按需识图（多 Provider 视觉 API）
- **modlens** —— 视觉 + 图片理解
- **agent-vision-toolkit** —— 视觉工具箱

我们写了篇 vision 接入指南（dshbase.com/blog/dsh-vision/），里面有图片上传被拒的修复和这几个插件的对比。

records.title: [Bug] Image upload rejected with "current model does not support images" even after switching to a non-DeepSeek model — custom pi-ai provider models silently default to text-only input
records.body:
### Summary

dsh Web UI (v0.1.0-rc.3) rejects image uploads with "当前模型不支持图片，请切换支持图片的模型" (the current model does not support images; switch to a model that does). The error persists even after switching to a model on a **custom OpenAI-compatible provider** (added via `~/.dsh/settings.yaml` under `llm-pi-ai`) that actually serves vision models. The root cause is that hand-declared models not present in the installed pi-ai catalog silently fall back to `inputModalities: ['text']`, and there is no UI surface to declare image support.

### Environment

- dsh version: 0.1.0-rc.3 (npm global install, `dsh web`), macOS
- Configuration: custom provider under `llm-pi-ai.providers` in `settings.yaml`, with hand-declared `models` entries (id + name only)

### Repro steps

1. In `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`, add a custom provider to `llm-pi-ai.providers` with an OpenAI-compatible `baseURL`/`api`, and hand-declare one or more models without an `input` field:

   ```yaml
   llm-pi-ai:
     providers:
       my-gateway:
         apiKeyEnv: MY_GATEWAY_API_KEY
         api: openai-responses
         baseURL: https://gateway.example.com/v1
         models:
           - id: vision-model
             name: Vision Model
   ```

2. Start `dsh web`, open a session, and switch the model picker to `vision-model`.
3. Upload an image and send.
4. The composer shows: 当前模型不支持图片，请切换支持图片的模型 (or in English: The current model does not support images; switch to a model that does).

### Expected behavior

After switching to a model that supports images, the image should be accepted and sent.

### Root cause

1. The `prompt` admission check in the host API (`packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts`) calls `ctx.llm.resolveModelInfo(provider, model)` and rejects the prompt when `inputModalities` is defined and does not include `image` (error code `MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES`). The same check also blocks model switching into a session that already contains images.

2. `dsh-llm-pi-ai` resolves a model's input modalities as: entry `input` → installed pi-ai catalog entry → route `defaultInput`, and **the route `defaultInput` itself defaults to `['text']`** (`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/config.ts`, `DEFAULT_INPUT`). Every model added through the web UI's "add a custom provider" card is hand-declared and unknown to the catalog, so it always resolves to text-only — no matter what the gateway actually serves.

3. This conservative default is deliberate (see Agent Note `.agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-08-12-pi-ai-route-default-input-modalities.md`): pi-ai silently downgrades images to a "(image omitted)" placeholder for models whose `input` lacks `image`, so refusing early is safer than claiming a capability the endpoint may not have. However, the remedy — writing `input: [text, image]` by hand in `settings.yaml` — is undiscoverable for web-only users, and the model-settings editor exposes neither the per-model `input` field nor the route-level `defaultInput`.

4. The error message itself ("switch to a model that does [support images]") offers no reachable fix, because no configuration surface could make a hand-declared model image-capable at the time.

### Fix

**Immediate workaround (no upgrade needed, hot-reloads):**

Declare image support at the route (applies to all undeclared models on the route) or per model:

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    my-gateway:
      # option A: route-level default for every undeclared model
      defaultInput: [text, image]
      models:
        - id: vision-model
          # option B: per-model declaration
          input: [text, image]
```

`settings.yaml` is watched by the settings service (chokidar, default on), so the change applies without restarting `dsh web`.

**Code fix (implemented locally, ready for upstream adoption):**

1. `packages/client/ui-settings-models`: the pi-ai model-list editor's advanced fold now has an "Image input" checkbox per model — checking it writes `input: ['text', 'image']`, unchecking drops the declaration. This closes the discoverability gap at the surface that creates hand-declared models. Tests added; `ModelListEditor.tsx` at 100% coverage.
2. `packages/client/ui-conversation`: the `MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES` message now points to the fix ("…or enable image input for it under Models settings" / 或在"设置→模型"中为该模型开启图片输入).
3. The Agent Note above was updated to reflect the editor change.

Validation: `test:gui` (3756 tests), `typecheck`, `lint`, `doc-sync` (28 gates), and per-file coverage all pass.

### Suggestion for maintainers

- Consider whether the "undeclared = text-only" default should distinguish **declared** text-only from **undeclared** (unknown), admitting images for unknown models and letting the provider decide — or keep the conservative default and ship the UI toggle (described above) so the remedy is reachable.
- The change also leaves the error message accurate while making the fix discoverable.

records.title: Proposal: allow image uploads in GUI when the main model is text-only but vision tools are installed
records.body:
## Summary

When using DeepSeek Harness with a **text-only main model** (e.g. DeepSeek V4 Flash via the deepseek-official provider) together with the vision plugin (dsh-vision-toolkit: vision_glance / vision_detect / vision_pixel_diff etc.), the GUI **rejects image uploads** with:

> 当前模型不支持图片，请切换支持图片的模型 (reason: `MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES`)

## Why this is a gap

The vision tools read image **paths** from the session workspace and work perfectly with a text-only model — we use them daily. But the GUI upload path in `dsh-host-apiproxy` assumes images can only be consumed as **model input**: when a prompt contains image parts it checks the current model's `inputModalities` and refuses when the model does not declare `"image"`.

So a text-only main model can never receive user images, even though the harness has vision tooling that could read them from disk.

## Suggested behavior

When the selected model does not support image input, do not reject the upload. Instead:

1. Save the uploaded image into the session workspace (e.g. `.dsh-uploads/`)
2. Hand the agent a **text reference** (file path) in the user message, e.g. `[用户上传了一张图片，已保存到 <path>。请使用 vision_glance 等视觉工具查看。]`

This matches the existing "images are for tools, not the model" architecture and makes the text-only + vision-tools combination fully usable from the GUI.

## Workaround

We currently apply a local patch to `dsh-host-apiproxy` that converts image parts into saved files + path references. It works well; it would be great to have this behavior built in (ideally configurable, e.g. only when the model lacks image input, or always when vision tools are present).

## Environment

- DeepSeek Harness latest rc
- DeepSeek V4 Flash (text-only) + dsh-vision-toolkit
- Web profile (browser GUI)

)
We do three things:
1. Admission: wraps the llm service via cordis's internal/get waterfall so resolveModelInfo reports image input for text-only routes — pasting images no longer fails with MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES (listModels stays truthful, the model picker is not misled).
2. LLM boundary: wraps prepareCall/stream as lazy generators that clone the (deep-frozen) request and project image blocks into explicit text placeholders carrying the attachmentId — no more UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT, the turn completes.
3. Delegation: the text-only main model hands the image to an in-session multimodal subagent, which reads the durable attachment via read_attachment — native multimodal comprehension (multi-turn follow-ups), no vision-API credentials, and the image stays inside the harness's own attachment store with session-scoped authorization.

This workflow is available without a Harness core patch through [pi2dsh](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh), using an explicit companion route rather than changing the capability declaration of the original text-only route.

Install the engine once, then the automatic vision bridge:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh@0.11.0
dsh plugin --profile web add @kassing/pi-vision
```

Point it at any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint:

```sh
export VISION_BRIDGE_BASE_URL=https://openrouter.ai/api/v1
export VISION_BRIDGE_MODEL=qwen/qwen2.5-vl-72b-instruct
export VISION_BRIDGE_API_KEY=$OPENROUTER_API_KEY
```

After restarting DSH, pi2dsh automatically registers a `<provider>-vision` companion for every text-only route. The Web picker shows **DeepSeek + Vision Bridge**, so pasted images pass admission there while the original DeepSeek route remains truthfully text-only.

Two verified consumption modes are available:

1. `@kassing/pi-vision` analyzes the attachment with the configured VLM and injects the analysis before the DeepSeek model step.
2. Alternatively, install `pi-vision-tool` to expose `describe_image`, letting the agent choose when to inspect a materialized image path.

Before forwarding to the original adapter, the companion removes image blocks recursively, including images nested in tool results. Existing path-based vision tools can use the materialized file path as well.

We verified the full DSH CLI and Web loops with independent image probes: the text-only DeepSeek route answered correctly, and the recorded request sent to DeepSeek contained no pixels.

Reproducible example: https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/tree/main/examples/vision-bridge

Same gate: the Web UI rejects the paste before any vision tool runs.

[dsh-plugin-multimodal](https://github.com/shinjiyu/dsh-plugin-multimodal) only opens admission so a text-only main model can accept a paste. It does not claim official DeepSeek can see images, and it is not a `vision_*` toolbox.

```
dsh plugin --profile web add github:shinjiyu/dsh-plugin-multimodal
```

Restart `dsh web`. [#1709](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1709)

records.title: [RFC] 跨对话引用：先挂现成工具，不要为 GUI 开基座
records.body:
用户要在当前对话里用上其他对话。有两条路，别混。

**1. Agent 自己去查（推荐，已有插件）**  
挂 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-session-query`。五个只读工具：搜会话、搜事件、读事件、看谱系。走 `ctx.sessionQuery`，按调用方 `cwd` 授权。默认组合没挂，opt-in 一行。不改 loop，不改 `session.prompt`，不做 Web `@`。

用户说「看昨天那个修 sandbox 的」，模型自己搜。卸掉插件，工具就没了。

不要用 bash 读 `~/.dsh` jsonl：会绕过授权和 compaction 表层。

**2. 输入框点选某一段对话**  
这才要动 host。今天 `session.prompt` 只能投递一条用户消息；浏览器调不到 `inject()`。要做 `@` chip，得给 host 一条 prompt 准入缝（waterfall，或给 prompt 加 `references[]`），再写 GUI。那是 `packages/client/*`，不是 harness 插件。

harness 插件 = agent 进程里的 Cordis（tool / context / service）。Web slot、`inputTriggers`、`dsh.client` 是另一套平面，贵一个数量级。没决定做输入框点选之前，不要为它开基座。

---

资料：[`tool-session-query`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/session-query/tool-session-query/README.md) · [`session-reference`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/context/session-reference/README.md) · [跨会话引用](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/.agents/notes/implemented/feature/2026-07-21-cross-session-references.md) · [context 与 turn 分离](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/.agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-07-24-separate-context-injection-from-turn-execution.md) · [`session.prompt`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts) · [封闭 RPC 表](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/host/apiproxy/src/api/rpc-map.ts)

records.title: Idea: 纯文本模型贴图不再被拒——受理时转本地路径交给视觉技能 / accept pasted images with text-only models (fix ready on fork)
records.body:
# DeepSeek Harness: pasted images are rejected before any vision skill can run

> Standalone problem report for the warning **"当前模型不支持图片输入 / This model does not support image input"** shown when pasting an image into the web chat while the routed model is text-only, plus the source fix prepared on the fork `deveuper/deepseek-harness` (branch `fix/text-only-model-image-admission`).
>
> 这是一份把"纯文本模型贴图即弹警告"现象单独提出的问题报告，并附上在 fork 分支 `fix/text-only-model-image-admission` 上已完成的源码修复说明。

## 1. Problem / 现象

- **What the user does / 用户操作:** paste or drag an image into the DeepSeek Harness web chat input box, with a text-only main model selected (DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM text models, etc.).
- **What happens now / 目前的效果:** sending fails immediately. The UI banner shows `当前模型不支持图片，请切换支持图片的模型` (attachment-error, reason `MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES`). The image is refused at the door and **never reaches the conversation**, so no skill can ever read it.
- **Root cause / 根因:** the prompt admission code in `packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts` rejects any prompt containing image blocks when the routed model's `inputModalities` does not include `image`. This check runs **before** skills can act.
- **Why this is a source bug, not a skill problem / 为什么是源码问题而非技能问题:** the block sits in the harness admission layer, ahead of every skill. **Any** script-based vision skill — visionDS, vision-hub, or any other vision/OCR helper — is affected equally, because the image is rejected before the skill can receive it. The advertised workflow "keep the text-only main model, let another vision model look at the image" is therefore impossible out of the box.

## 2. The fix / 修复内容

Keep the main model text-only (unchanged), persist the uploaded images durably, and hand the model **local file paths** as text. The model then feeds those paths to a vision skill/script through its shell tools.

- `packages/attachment/attachment/src/index.ts` — add `AttachmentStore.imagePath(ref)` to the seam: resolve a stored image to its absolute local filesystem path.
- `packages/attachment/attachment-local/src/index.ts` / `src/store.ts` — implement `imagePath` and export `attachmentObjectPath(root, ref)`.
- `packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts` — prompt admission: when the routed model declares `inputModalities` without `image`, persist the uploads exactly as before (`durablePromptContent`), then replace the image blocks with text blocks carrying each stored image's local path, its media type, and a hint to use the `vision-ds` skill. The durable user message stays text-only, so the text-only LLM adapter never sees an image block and the "model-visible ⟺ logged" invariant holds.
- Tests — new coverage in `packages/host/apiproxy/tests/api-proxy-models.spec.ts` (image → path-text conversion for a text-only model) and `packages/attachment/attachment-local/tests/store.spec.ts` (`attachmentObjectPath`); the new abstract member is implemented in the existing test/tooling attachment stores (`packages/fs/tool-fs/tests/read-image.spec.ts`, `packages/host/apiproxy/tests/api-proxy-projections.spec.ts`, `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/tests/adapter.spec.ts`, `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/tests/provider-apis.e2e.ts`, `scripts/gen-tool-catalog.ts`, `scripts/test-invariants.ts`).

## 3. Why remove the warning / 为什么去掉这条警告

- With the warning, the image is rejected at admission, so **no vision skill can ever work** with a text-only main model. Removing the rejection is the only way to enable the "main model stays, vision goes elsewhere" workflow.
- The change is additive and safe: the main model still receives only text; images are stored in the durable attachment store exactly as the vision-capable path does; models that DO declare image input keep the previous behavior (real image blocks) unchanged.
- The client-side copy mapping for `MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES` stays in place for any other surface that still emits it; only the ordinary session admission path stops emitting it. The separate subagent-continuation guard (`SUBAGENT_IMAGE_UNSUPPORTED`) is untouched by this change.

## 4. Verification / 验证

- `tsc -b tsconfig.host.json` — clean.
- Affected vitest suites — **104 passed** (`api-proxy-models`, `api-proxy-projections`, `attachment-local/store`, `tool-fs/read-image`, `llm-pi-ai/adapter`).
- End-to-end on this machine — a pasted-style PNG is persisted under `~/.dsh/attachments/v1`, the text-only model receives the local path, the `vision-ds` skill script reads it, and a real MiMo vision API call returned a correct description of the image (620 tokens). Windows built-in OCR fallback also verified.

## 5. Links / 相关链接

- Fix branch on the fork: <https://github.com/deveuper/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/text-only-model-image-admission> (commit `9f56c37e48`)
- Ready-to-apply diff against official `master`: <https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/compare/master...deveuper:fix/text-only-model-image-admission>
- The skill that consumes the paths: <https://github.com/deveuper/visionDS>
- Official discussion (this report): <https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/427>
- Official discussion (visionDS announcement): <https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/384>

records.title: [Bug Report] 子代理继承父代理的"创建时默认模型"而非"会话当前模型"，第三方 provider 会话中 subagent 必报 no API key for provider route "deepseek-official"
records.body:
## 摘要

子代理（subagent）的模型路由继承自父代理的 `AgentOptions`（`dsh-subagent` 的 `resolveChildAgentOptions`），而 Web 会话里父代理的 `options.provider` 在**创建时被固化为默认模型选择**（`agentDefaultModel`）。父代理**实际运行**所用的模型则是**会话级选择**（会话内切换的模型，记录在 session 的 request header / in-process 选择表里，`selectionFor` 的优先级：in-process 选择 → 会话日志 → 默认）。两条链不一致：当会话运行在第三方 provider（自建网关/兼容 API）而默认选择仍是官方路由时，父代理一切正常，但模型一调用子代理，子代理就按默认路由 `deepseek-official` 解析凭据（找 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`），用户根本没有该 key → `llm-deepseek: no API key for provider route "deepseek-official"`。这正是 #117 的现象：第三方 API 下，模型调用子代理必失败。

## 根因（源码定位，rc.6）

1. `dsh-host-apiproxy/lib/index.js` L1708-1714：Web 会话创建/恢复时的 seed options——
   ```js
   const agentOptions = () => {
     const { provider, model } = defaults.defaultModelSelection();  // 默认选择，非会话选择
     return { provider, model };
   };
   ```
   父代理 `options.provider` 从此固化。
2. 同文件 `selectionFor()`（L1750-1773）：父代理**实际**每轮请求用的模型解析优先级是
   in-process 选择 → `agent.session.requestHeader()?.config`（会话里选过的模型）→
   默认选择。会话级切换只落在这一层，**不回写 `parent.options`**。
3. `dsh-subagent/lib/types/child-agent.js` `resolveChildAgentOptions()`（L51-62）：
   ```js
   const parentProvider = parent.options.provider;   // ← 创建时固化的默认路由
   const parentModel = parent.options.model;
   ```
   子代理只继承这两个字段，完全看不到第 2 条的会话级选择。
4. `dsh-llm-deepseek/lib/index.js` `resolveApiKey()`（L740-750）：子代理按
   `deepseek-official` 路由解析 `apiKeyEnv`（默认 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`），
   credentials 服务与启动环境都没有该 ref → 抛 `MISSING_CREDENTIAL`。
   第三方用户的 key 存在他们自己的网关 ref 下，永远匹配不上。

链路总结：**会话级模型选择（父代理实际路线）≠ `parent.options`（创建时的默认路线）→ 子代理继承后者 → 路由到默认 provider → 凭据解析必然落空。**

## 复现步骤

1. 默认模型选择保持官方 `deepseek-official`（不配 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`，或配一个不存在的值）。
2. 在**某个会话内**把模型切换为自建网关/第三方兼容 provider（配置了可用 key），此时主代理对话一切正常。
3. 在该会话中让模型调用子代理工具（subagent / 后台子代理）。
4. 结果：子代理首轮即报
   `llm-deepseek: no API key for provider route "deepseek-official"; store DEEPSEEK_API_KEY ...`
   （#117 原报错）。
5. 对照：把默认模型选择也改成该第三方 provider → 子代理正常（证明断点就在"继承对象选错"）。

## 建议修复

**方案 A（推荐）· 继承父代理的"有效模型"而非创建时 options**：在 `resolveChildAgentOptions`（或驱动器调用点）处，按与父代理一致的优先级解析父代理当前有效的 provider/model（in-process 选择 → session request header → 默认选择）再传给子代理。改动集中在 `dsh-subagent` 一处，语义正确：子代理永远跟随父代理此刻实际在用的路线。

**方案 B · 会话级选择同步回写 options**：每次 `session.selectModel`/in-process 选择变更时同步更新 `parent.options.provider/model`，使 options 始终等于有效路线。改动面更广（要处理回写与持久化一致性），不如 A 干净。

**方案 C（缓解）· 子代理报错信息补充实际路由与继承来源**：即使短期不修，`MISSING_CREDENTIAL` 时提示"该路由来自父代理创建时的默认模型选择，当前会话运行的是 X"，可大幅减少定位时间。

## 影响

- 所有"默认官方 + 会话内切第三方网关"的用户，子代理工作流 100% 不可用（subagent、后台子代理、workflow 分叉均受影响）
- 与 #117 完全吻合；#422（多子任务后主任务 HTTP 400）可能同源或相关

## 环境

- 源码定位：0.1.0-rc.6（npx 缓存安装包，Node v24.16.0，Windows 11）
- 原报告：#117（第三方 api 时模型调用子代理失败，0 评论，此前无人分析）

## 验证材料

- 四个源码定位点（文件+行号）见"根因"节，链路可静态复读
- 复现步骤 5 步可任意环境执行；第 5 步的对照实验（改默认选择即恢复）是最强验证

---

*First analysis of discussion #117. Happy to open a PR with fix option A.*

comments.body:
补充一个不同表现但同根因的场景，以及源码定位确认。

**场景**：provider A（按周配额计费的第三方通道）配额用尽后，将其从配置中删除，并把 `settings.yaml` 的 `agent-default-model` 改为 provider B。回到原会话派子代理，仍然走已删除的 provider A，报 `NO_ADAPTER: no adapter registered for provider "A"`；在 UI 手动切换会话模型到 B 后再派子代理，仍然报错。只能新建会话绕过。

这与楼主分析的根因完全一致——子代理继承的是会话创建时固化的 `parent.options.provider/model`，而非会话当前实际生效的模型。

**源码定位**（rc.6）：

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent/lib/types/child-agent.js` L43-57，子代理创建时无条件继承父代理的 provider/model：

```js
// Resolve the child's AgentOptions: the parent's provider/model/maxTokens
const parentProvider = parent.options.provider;
const parentModel = parent.options.model;
...parentProvider !== undefined ? { provider: parentProvider } : {},
...parentModel !== undefined ? { model: parentModel } : {},
```

该继承路径无视 `agent-default-model` 的变更，且会话级模型切换不回写 `parent.options`，导致旧会话新派的子代理永久锁死在失效 provider 上。

赞同方案 A：在 `resolveChildAgentOptions` 处按与父代理一致的优先级解析当前有效 provider/model 再传给子代理。

On rc.7, the reliable workaround is to select the intended provider and model with `/model`, then start a new parent session before delegating. When settings are writable, that selector saves the route as the default for newly created agents; changing only an already-running parent does not update the provider and model a child inherits.

这条根因（子代理拿到"创建时默认"而不是"会话当前模型"）我们在另一条路线上也撞到过同形状的坑，供参考——**不是修 DSH 原生 subagent，而是 Pi 插件生态那条子代理路线**：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile main add pi2dsh
dsh plugin --profile main add @tintinweb/pi-subagents
```

重启后模型获得 Agent / steer_subagent / get_subagent_result 工具。已实证的部分（stock CLI + 真模型端到端）：per-child 显式指定模型（Agent 工具的 `model` 参数）；**插件面** `ctx.setModel()` 会话内切换后派生的子代理跟随当前路由（我们第一版也犯了"只读创建时 `agent.options` 快照"的错——和本帖源码定位同一条链——靠"子会话 request/header 的 provider 必须等于父会话当前 provider"这条断言抓出来修掉的）。

**如实说明边界**：DSH UI/`/model` 切换那半边的贯通我们还没接完——切换事实在父会话日志的 request/header 里，派生时读它即可，正在补这条并配"UI 真切换 → 派生 → 核验双方 request/header"的 E2E；接通前，UI 切换后派生的子代理在这条路线上同样会读到旧路由。

每个子代理是原生 DSH 会话（带官方 subagent/descriptor 与父血缘），宿主可列可续。示例与已过的四场景验收（steer / resume / stop / 跨重启重开）：
https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/tree/main/examples/subagents

records.title: llm-pi-ai compat schema drops most pi-ai OpenAICompletionsCompat fields (e.g. supportsDeveloperRole) for hand-declared providers
records.body:
## Summary

Custom (hand-declared) providers on non-OpenAI-compatible endpoints cannot express most pi-ai compatibility flags through `llm-pi-ai` settings. The settings schema only accepts `thinkingFormat` and `supportsReasoningEffort`; everything else in pi-ai's `OpenAICompletionsCompat` — including `supportsDeveloperRole`, `maxTokensField`, `supportsStore` — is silently dropped. For endpoints pi-ai's URL auto-detection does not recognize (e.g. Volcano Ark `ark.cn-beijing.volces.com`, Kimi Coding `api.kimi.com`), this makes reasoning-capable custom routes unusable.

## Environment

- dsh `0.1.0-rc.6` via `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`
- Linux x86_64
- Custom providers declared in `~/.dsh/settings.yaml` under `llm-pi-ai.providers`

## Steps to reproduce

1. Declare a custom route against Volcano Ark:

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    ark-coding:
      api: openai-completions
      baseURL: https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/coding/v3
      apiKeyEnv: ARK_CODING_API_KEY
      displayName: Volcano Ark Coding Plan
      models:
        - id: deepseek-v4-pro
          contextWindow: 1048000
          reasoningEfforts: { low: low, high: high, max: max }
      compat:
        thinkingFormat: deepseek
        supportsReasoningEffort: true
```

2. Start a session with this provider and any model that declares `reasoningEfforts`.
3. Send a message.

## Actual behavior

The upstream returns HTTP 400:

```json
{"code":"InvalidParameter","message":"The parameter `messages.role` specified in the request are not valid: invalid value: `developer`, supported values are: `system`, `assistant`, `user`, `tool`."}
```

## Root cause

In `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai` the settings compat schema only has two fields:

```ts
const compatProfile = z.object({
  thinkingFormat: z.union(SUPPORTED_THINKING_FORMATS),
  supportsReasoningEffort: z.boolean()
});
```

Meanwhile pi-ai's `OpenAICompletionsCompat` (used at request time) has ~20 fields, and its URL auto-detection (`detectCompat`) defaults `supportsDeveloperRole` to `true` for any endpoint not on its known list (`deepseek.com`, `opencode.ai`, `api.x.ai`, `api.z.ai`, `api.moonshot.*`, …). `ark.cn-beijing.volces.com` and `api.kimi.com` are not on that list.

Chain:

1. A hand-declared model gets `reasoning: true` once `reasoningEfforts` is declared (good — effort selection works).
2. `openai-completions.js` then computes `useDeveloperRole = model.reasoning && compat.supportsDeveloperRole`.
3. Because the settings schema dropped `supportsDeveloperRole: false`, detection defaults to `true`, so the system prompt is sent with role `developer`.
4. The CN endpoints reject it (they only accept `system` / `assistant` / `user` / `tool`).

Note this also means models on these endpoints that do NOT declare reasoning work by accident (role falls back to `system` when `reasoning` is false) — the failure appears exactly when you enable the reasoning feature, which is confusing.

## Workaround used

A local micro-proxy that rewrites `role: developer` → `system` (and strips `store`) before forwarding. Works, but shouldn't be necessary.

## Request

1. Let the `llm-pi-ai` settings `compat` (route-level and per-model) pass through the full pi-ai `OpenAICompletionsCompat` surface — at minimum `supportsDeveloperRole`, ideally `maxTokensField` / `supportsStore` / `requiresAssistantAfterToolResult` as well — instead of silently dropping unknown keys. Silent dropping makes misconfiguration undiagnosable.
2. Consider expanding pi-ai's URL auto-detection for common CN-compatible endpoints (Volcano Ark `*.volces.com`, Kimi `api.kimi.com`, DashScope `*.aliyuncs.com`), or at least log a warning when a hand-declared route's compat comes entirely from URL guessing.

Thanks!

comments.body: Same problem!

同样撞到这个问题。现在有一条不需要自建 rewrite proxy 的可用绕路：让对应的 Pi provider 插件经 [pi2dsh](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh) 注册成 DSH 原生 LLM route，绕开会丢 compat 字段的 `llm-pi-ai` settings schema。

原帖里的两个端点在 Pi 生态都有现成 provider 包：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh@0.12.0
dsh plugin --profile web add pi-volcengine-provider   # Volcano Ark Coding
# 或：dsh plugin --profile web add pi-provider-kimi-code
```

重启 DSH 后，模型直接出现在 DSH 自己的模型选择器里。会话、日志、重试、子代理和权限仍由 DSH 管理，只有请求 adapter 来自 Pi provider。

这条链路已经验证到 wire：Pi 模型声明 `compat.supportsDeveloperRole: false` 后，实际发出的是 `system` 而不是 `developer`；同时在 DSH 选择的 `high` 推理档位也确实传到了 provider，不会出现“选择器有档位但请求没带”的情况。无需真实网关也可以用仓库里的 [`examples/gateway-compat/probe`](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/tree/main/examples/gateway-compat/probe) 复现。

边界说明：这不是修复了 DSH 的 settings 路径；继续用手写 `llm-pi-ai` route 时字段仍会被丢。它提供的是另一条已验证的原生 route。

records.title: llm-pi-ai 的 compat schema 丢弃了 pi-ai OpenAICompletionsCompat 大部分字段（如 supportsDeveloperRole），导致手写 provider 不可用
records.body:
## 摘要

自定义（手写声明）provider 无法通过 `llm-pi-ai` 设置表达 pi-ai 的大部分兼容性开关。settings 的 schema 只接受 `thinkingFormat` 和 `supportsReasoningEffort` 两个字段，pi-ai `OpenAICompletionsCompat` 中的其余字段——包括 `supportsDeveloperRole`、`maxTokensField`、`supportsStore`——会被静默丢弃。对于 pi-ai URL 自动探测不认识的端点（如火山方舟 `ark.cn-beijing.volces.com`、Kimi Coding `api.kimi.com`），这会导致支持推理（reasoning）的自定义路由完全不可用。

## 环境

- dsh `0.1.0-rc.6`（`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`）
- Linux x86_64
- 自定义 provider 声明在 `~/.dsh/settings.yaml` 的 `llm-pi-ai.providers` 下

## 复现步骤

1. 声明一个指向火山方舟的自定义路由：

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    ark-coding:
      api: openai-completions
      baseURL: https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/coding/v3
      apiKeyEnv: ARK_CODING_API_KEY
      displayName: Volcano Ark Coding Plan
      models:
        - id: deepseek-v4-pro
          contextWindow: 1048000
          reasoningEfforts: { low: low, high: high, max: max }
      compat:
        thinkingFormat: deepseek
        supportsReasoningEffort: true
```

2. 用该 provider 中任意声明了 `reasoningEfforts` 的模型开启会话。
3. 发送消息。

## 实际表现

上游返回 HTTP 400：

```json
{"code":"InvalidParameter","message":"The parameter `messages.role` specified in the request are not valid: invalid value: `developer`, supported values are: `system`, `assistant`, `user`, `tool`."}
```

## 根因

`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai` 中 settings 的 compat schema 只有两个字段：

```ts
const compatProfile = z.object({
  thinkingFormat: z.union(SUPPORTED_THINKING_FORMATS),
  supportsReasoningEffort: z.boolean()
});
```

而 pi-ai 请求时使用的 `OpenAICompletionsCompat` 约有 20 个字段，其 URL 自动探测（`detectCompat`）对不在已知名单（`deepseek.com`、`opencode.ai`、`api.x.ai`、`api.z.ai`、`api.moonshot.*` 等）内的端点，`supportsDeveloperRole` 默认按 `true` 处理。`ark.cn-beijing.volces.com` 和 `api.kimi.com` 不在名单内。

因果链：

1. 手写模型一旦声明 `reasoningEfforts`，`reasoning` 变为 `true`（这是好的——力度选择生效了）。
2. `openai-completions.js` 计算 `useDeveloperRole = model.reasoning && compat.supportsDeveloperRole`。
3. 由于 settings schema 丢弃了 `supportsDeveloperRole: false`，探测默认 `true`，系统提示以 `developer` 角色发送。
4. 国产端点拒绝该角色（只接受 `system` / `assistant` / `user` / `tool`）。

注意：这同时意味着这些端点上**未声明推理的模型能"碰巧"正常工作**（`reasoning` 为 `false` 时角色回落到 `system`）——故障恰好在你启用推理功能时出现，非常具有迷惑性。

## 当前使用的绕过方案

本地微型代理把 `role: developer` 改写为 `system`（并剥离 `store` 字段）后转发。能用，但不应该需要这样做。

## 请求

1. 让 `llm-pi-ai` settings 的 `compat`（路由级与模型级）透传 pi-ai `OpenAICompletionsCompat` 的完整字段——至少 `supportsDeveloperRole`，最好还有 `maxTokensField` / `supportsStore` / `requiresAssistantAfterToolResult`——而不是静默丢弃未知键。静默丢弃让错误配置无法被诊断。
2. 考虑扩充 pi-ai 的 URL 自动探测，覆盖常见国产兼容端点（火山方舟 `*.volces.com`、Kimi `api.kimi.com`、阿里百炼 `*.aliyuncs.com`），或者至少在自定义路由的 compat 完全依赖 URL 猜测时输出警告日志。

谢谢！

comments.body:
这份根因分析是对的。补一个不需要改 `node_modules` 或自建 rewrite proxy 的现成绕法：通过 [pi2dsh](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh) 使用对应的 Pi provider 插件。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh
dsh plugin --profile web add <对应网关的 Pi provider 包>
```

provider 自带 transport 时会经 DSH 官方 `llm.registerAdapter` 注册为原生 route；请求读取 provider 自己模型描述上的完整 `compat`，不经过手写 `llm-pi-ai` profile 的字段白名单。

线上录制已经确认 `supportsDeveloperRole: false` 发出 `system`，provider 的 `maxTokensField` 和 thinking level map 也能到请求。边界是原 settings 路径仍未修，这是一条可安装的替代 route。

records.title: 有没有什么办法让dsv4在dsh里也能接收图片输入？
records.body:
我用的是deepseek-v4-pro。为了让它能识图，我搭了常见的「视觉代理」方案：用一个 skill 调外部视觉 API把图片转成文字描述，再交给纯文本模型推理。
但卡点是：DSH 对纯文本模型完全禁止图片输入。Web GUI 的贴图按钮被禁用，服务端也拒绝带图消息：
Model "…" does not accept image input, but this session already contains images; select an image-capable model.
Model "…" does not support image input.

### 在源码里定位到的根因

@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek 在 modelInfo() 和 resolveModel() 里硬编码了 inputModalities: ["text"]，且没有配置项可覆盖。
@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-apiproxy 用 inputModalities.includes("image") 来拦截图片内容。
@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs 的 read_image 工具也按 inputModalities.includes("image") 做门禁。

### 试过的绕行方案

1.通过 llm-pi-ai 把视觉模型注册成 OpenAI 兼容路由，需要看图时切换过去。能用，但整轮都得离开 DeepSeek，无法实现「DeepSeek 负责推理 + 外部 API 负责视觉」的模式。

2.把图片路径或 URL 当纯文本发过去，让 skill 自己跑视觉脚本。能用，但不是真正的附件体验（没有拖拽/粘贴）。

### 想请教

1.有没有受支持的方式，能让纯文本模型也能接收图片附件——例如把图片存成持久化附件，并把它的本地文件路径（或一个能落地成临时文件的工具）暴露给模型，而不要求模型本身声明 image 输入？

2.或者，能否让 DeepSeek 适配器（以及一般纯文本适配器）支持通过配置声明/覆盖 inputModalities，让「视觉代理」流程能先接收附件，再交给调用外部视觉 API 的 skill/tool 处理？

records.title: llm-pi-ai: expose `supportsDeveloperRole` in `PiAiCompatProfile` (reasoning models break on endpoints that reject the `developer` role)
records.body:
## Summary

`llm-pi-ai`'s `PiAiCompatProfile` exposes `thinkingFormat` and `supportsReasoningEffort`, but not `supportsDeveloperRole` — a field `@earendil-works/pi-ai`'s `OpenAICompletionsCompat` already supports. Because dsh does not forward it, a reasoning model served through an OpenAI-compatible gateway that rejects the `developer` role is impossible to configure correctly, and every request fails with the provider's `finish_reason: content_filter`.

## Repro

1. Declare an `openai-completions` route with a reasoning model that carries `reasoningEfforts` (so `model.reasoning` is truthy):

```yaml
providers:
  my-gateway:
    api: openai-completions
    baseURL: https://copilot.tencent.com/v2
    models:
      - id: deepseek-v4-pro
        reasoningEfforts:
          off:
          low: low
          high: high
```

2. Make a request with a reasoning effort (e.g. `reasoningEffort: high`).

3. Observed: the gateway returns `finish_reason: content_filter`.

## Root cause

In `@earendil-works/pi-ai`, the system prompt is sent as either `system` or `developer`:

```js
const useDeveloperRole = model.reasoning && compat.supportsDeveloperRole;
const role = useDeveloperRole ? "developer" : "system";
params.push({ role, content: systemPrompt });
```

pi-ai defaults `supportsDeveloperRole` from endpoint detection (`!isNonStandard && !isOpenRouter`), so any standard-looking OpenAI-compatible base URL gets `true`, and reasoning models therefore send the `developer` role. Some gateways (e.g. `copilot.tencent.com/v2`) do not accept the `developer` role and answer `content_filter`.

dsh's `resolveModelCompat` (`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/catalog.ts`) only forwards the two exposed fields:

```ts
return { compat: {
  ...inherited,
  ...thinkingFormat === undefined ? {} : { thinkingFormat },
  ...supportsReasoningEffort === undefined ? {} : { supportsReasoningEffort },
} };
```

so `model.compat.supportsDeveloperRole` is always left to pi-ai's URL-derived default, with no way to override it to `false`.

## Proposed change

Add an optional `supportsDeveloperRole?: boolean` to `PiAiCompatProfile`, wire it through `resolveModelCompat`, and add it to the `compatProfile` zod schema (all three are one-line edits). This would let a profile opt out with:

```yaml
compat:
  thinkingFormat: openai
  supportsReasoningEffort: true
  supportsDeveloperRole: false
```

## Workaround

Until this is exposed, I patch the compiled `dsh-llm-pi-ai/lib/index.js` after install to append `supportsDeveloperRole: false` to the compat object — a fragile stopgap that is lost whenever the npx cache is refreshed.

comments.body:
这里已经有一条无需修改安装目录的替代路径。[pi2dsh](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh) 可以把网关对应的 Pi provider package 注册为 DSH 原生 LLM adapter，绕过会丢 `supportsDeveloperRole` 的手写 profile schema。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh
dsh plugin --profile web add <对应网关的 Pi provider 包>
```

provider 自带 transport 时，自己的 `compat` 与 reasoning level map 直接参与请求组装。透传抓包确认：`supportsDeveloperRole: false` 后请求使用 `system`；在 DSH 里选择的 effort 也确实传到 stream，而不是只显示一个菜单。

因此 CodeBuddy/LiteLLM 等有对应 Pi provider 的网关可以先这样用；这不等于上游 `PiAiCompatProfile` 已修。

records.title: Feature request: image attachments with a text-only main model via a separate vision model (MCP vision-helper)
records.body:
## Summary

When the active session model is text-only (e.g. `deepseek-v4-flash`, which the `dsh-llm-deepseek` adapter declares with `inputModalities: ["text"]`), the harness **rejects image attachments at the GUI/host admission layer** with:

> `当前模型不支持图片，请切换支持图片的模型` (`MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES` / `attachment-error`)

This blocks a very common private-deployment setup: a **text-only main model** + a **separate multimodal model** (e.g. Qwen3.6-27B served via llama.cpp) used as a "vision helper". The user never gets to attach the image — it is rejected before it reaches the session, so no agent-side routing to a vision tool is possible.

## Use case

- Main model: text-only (DeepSeek official API).
- Vision helper: privately deployed multimodal model (OpenAI-compatible `/v1/chat/completions`, `image_url` with data URLs), already working as an MCP server exposing `describe_image(path)`.
- Desired flow: user drags/pastes an image in the GUI → harness stores it as a durable attachment → the model receives a **text placeholder with the attachment reference** → the agent calls the vision MCP tool with that reference → the returned text description enters context → the text-only main model answers.

## Current behavior (0.1.0-rc.6)

- Admission gate in `dsh-host-apiproxy` (session prompt admission and `selectModel`): rejects when `modelInfo.inputModalities !== undefined && !inputModalities.includes("image")`.
- `dsh-llm-deepseek` hardcodes `inputModalities: ["text"]` in `modelInfo()` and in `resolveModel()`'s fallback branch.
- `read_image` (dsh-tool-fs) has a stricter gate: it requires the resolved route to declare `image` input explicitly (`inputModalities === undefined` is rejected), and it returns an **image block** — which the DeepSeek chat-completions adapter rejects with `UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT`, so it cannot serve as the vision bridge either.
- The MCP workaround works fine **when given a file path** (image stored anywhere readable), but the GUI attachment path never yields a reference the agent can see.

## Feature suggestions (any of these would unblock the pattern)

1. **Admission option for text-only models**: a per-session/deployment setting that allows image intake even when the active model is text-only — persist the image as a durable attachment and give the model a text placeholder carrying the attachment id/reference (e.g. `[图片 attachmentId=xxx]`), so the agent can hand it to a vision tool. The provider adapter still never receives image bytes.
2. **Modality override in model config**: allow deployments to override `inputModalities` per provider/model (e.g. keep `deepseek-v4-flash` text-only on the wire, but let a deployment opt into image intake), instead of the adapter being the only source of truth.
3. **Attachment reference exposure**: when image admission is allowed for a text-only model, surface the `sha256:`/attachment reference to the agent (e.g. in the message text projection), and add a small host tool to resolve an attachment id to its stored path (or bytes), so MCP/vision tools can consume it without the user needing to manage files manually.

## Notes on our current workaround

We built a stdio MCP server (FastMCP) wrapping the private multimodal endpoint, registered via `cordis.patch.yml` with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` (tools appear as `mcp__vision__describe_image`). It works end-to-end when invoked with a filesystem path. The only missing piece is the GUI attachment pipeline for text-only sessions.

Environment: dsh `0.1.0-rc.6`, profile `web`, Windows host.

comments.body:
This is the GUI admission gap in #588: text-only main model + a separate vision helper.

[dsh-plugin-multimodal](https://github.com/shinjiyu/dsh-plugin-multimodal) sits in the adapter layer, not as a `vision_*` toolbox.

- If the routed model already accepts images, attachments pass through unchanged.
- If it is text-only, the plugin advertises image input so the Web UI accepts the paste, then a vision sidecar describes the image and the main model only sees text.
- `see_image` covers screenshots already on disk.

It does not replace Anionex/`dsh-vision-toolkit`. That package is tools the agent must call. This one is so paste is not rejected.

Install:

```
dsh plugin --profile web add github:shinjiyu/dsh-plugin-multimodal
```

Then restart dsh. Set `DSH_VISION_BASE_URL` / `DSH_VISION_API_KEY` / `DSH_VISION_MODEL` to a real vision model (not `deepseek-v4-flash` / `GLM-5.2-FP8`).

Repo: https://github.com/shinjiyu/dsh-plugin-multimodal

The missing GUI attachment pipeline in this exact setup is now available in `pi2dsh`, and it can reuse your existing `mcp__vision__describe_image(path)` server.

Install the engine once:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh@0.11.0
```

After restarting DSH, every text-only route automatically gets a **DeepSeek + Vision Bridge** companion in the Web model picker. The companion accepts pasted or dragged images, materializes each attachment to a temporary file, and gives the agent an actionable text notice containing that path. Your existing MCP server can remain unchanged: DeepSeek can pass the path directly to `mcp__vision__describe_image`.

You can also use either Pi vision package as published:

```sh
# Automatic VLM analysis + context injection
dsh plugin --profile web add @kassing/pi-vision

# Agent-controlled describe_image tool
dsh plugin --profile web add pi-vision-tool
```

The original `deepseek-official` route remains text-only. Before forwarding to it, the bridge recursively strips every image block, including nested tool-result content, so the official DeepSeek API receives text only. No generated bundle or manual modality override is required.

We verified the real DSH Web loop with pasted image probes and contract coverage for path-bearing placeholders, nested image removal, original-route forwarding, and the original text-only model identity seen by Pi plugins.

Full example: https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/tree/main/examples/vision-bridge

records.body:
在配置settings.yaml配置了reasoningEfforts字段
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    positec:
      displayName: ××××
      apiKeyEnv: ××××××
      api: openai-completions
      baseURL: ×××××××
      models:
        - id: deepseek-v4-flash
          contextWindow: 1000000
          maxTokens: 256000
          reasoningEfforts:
            off:
            high: high
            max: max
        - id: deepseek-v4-pro
          contextWindow: 1000000
          maxTokens: 256000

            界面出现了可以选择的思考强度，但是实际聊天报错：
            400: {"message":"Failed to deserialize the JSON body into the target type: messages[0].role: unknown variant `developer`, expected one of `system`, `user`, `assistant`, `tool`, `latest_reminder` at line 1 column 60","type":"invalid_request_error","param":"","code":"invalid_request_error"}

comments.body: 我可以的，你这个配置有问题吧

replies.body: 我没找到在什么地方设置思考强度怎么

comments.body:
声明 reasoningEfforts 后模型被视为推理模型，system prompt 会以 developer role 发送，而第三方 OpenAI 兼容端点（positec 等）只认 system，所以 400。临时方案是去掉模型条目的 reasoningEfforts（或设 false），代价是思考强度不可用。
也可以改用 OpenCode 官方网关（我本地就是这么跑的）
DeepSeek 官方提供 OpenCode Zen / OpenCode Go 网关（opencode.ai），它兼容 developer role 和 reasoning_effort 参数，所以思考强度（low/high/max）能正常用，不会报 400。我的配置：

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    opencode-go:
      displayName: OpenCode Go
      apiKeyEnv: OCG_API_KEY      # 环境变量里配 opencode.ai 的 API key
agent-default-model:
  provider: opencode-go
  model: deepseek-v4-flash
  reasoningEffort: max
```

模型走 openai-completions 协议，deepseek-v4-flash 支持 low/high/max 三档思考强度，请求直接发 reasoning_effort: max。
rang让DSH给你搞个委派路由并能设置思考模式就行了 不仅主代理可以子代理也可以用自己的思考强度。再牛逼点让主代理可以根据任务强度自动分配思考强度

你这里不是 `reasoningEfforts` 写错了：声明它以后模型被识别成 reasoning model，但私有网关又被误判为支持 `developer`，而 DSH settings 不能把 `supportsDeveloperRole: false` 传下去。

不禁用思考档位的绕法是使用带 transport 的 Pi provider route：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh
dsh plugin --profile web add <对应网关的 Pi provider 包>
```

[pi2dsh](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh) 会把它注册进 DSH 原生模型选择器，同时保留 provider 的 `compat` 和 thinking level map。我们抓过实际请求：选 High 后 effort 真进入请求，system prompt 使用 `system` 而不是 `developer`。

如果网关入口是 LiteLLM，可直接用 `pi-provider-litellm`。

感谢这份非常专业的分析！逐点核对后，你的机制分析完全正确，我们也分别在 pi-ai 源码和真实端点上做了实证，把结论同步一下：

一、机制确认


pi-ai openai-completions.js:787 的判定我们核实了：const useDeveloperRole = model.reasoning && compat.supportsDeveloperRole;


自定义网关 provider（如 CodeBuddy 的 copilot.tencent.com）确实不在 isNonStandard 名单（名单只有 nvidia/cerebras/xai/together/deepseek.com/zai/moonshot 等），默认 supportsDeveloperRole=true → reasoning 模型发 developer role → 腾讯网关 content-audit 拒绝。compat 配置面确实没有 supportsDeveloperRole 开关（compatProfile schema 只有 thinkingFormat 和 supportsReasoningEffort 两项）——这个缺口值得给 pi-ai 上游提个 issue。


二、官方端点实测：强度传递全部有效


对三个官方 provider 各发两遍同一问题（强度关 vs 高），实测：


- DeepSeek 官方（OpenAI · reasoning_effort）：强度高 → HTTP 200，reasoning_tokens = 42，思考真实发生；强度关 → pi-ai 按 thinkingLevelMap off→null 正确省略字段。✅ 生效
- Kimi K3 coding plan（Anthropic · thinking budget）：强度关 → thinking_tokens = 46；强度高 → thinking_tokens = 67，budget 调节可见。✅ 生效（K3 恒思考是网关特性，budget 仍起作用）
- ZAI GLM bigmodel coding（OpenAI · thinking 参数）：thinking disabled → reasoning_content = 0 字符；enabled → 310 字符。✅ 生效，开关灵


role 形态：DeepSeek / ZAI 在 pi-ai 内置目录均为 supportsDeveloperRole: false（发送 system role）；Kimi 走 Anthropic 协议（无 developer 概念）。三家官方端点的 role 和强度都没有问题。







三、CodeBuddy 网关：两条实测结论


1. developer role：我们目前的解法是本地 60 行 Node 转发器（127.0.0.1:8790，developer→system 改写后原样透传含 reasoning_effort 的完整请求体），settings.yaml 的 baseURL 指向它。工作稳定，缺点是依赖本机进程——你说的 pi2dsh 路线确实更通用，认可。
2. thinking 参数：腾讯网关忽略 thinking 参数（我们 8/14 抓包结论：GLM 在该网关恒定思考）——字段正确送达但档位无效，属网关侧行为，客户端无解。


四、插件本身零网关依赖

records.title: 联网搜索能否兼容其他模型
records.body: 联网搜索能否兼容其他模型，我看插件是写死访问deepseek的联网搜索功能

comments.body:
可以，`web_search` 本身**不是写死 DeepSeek 的** —— 它是可插拔 provider 架构。

## 现状

- `dsh-tool-web` 提供模型侧的 `web_search` 工具，它**只负责"调 `ctx.web` 搜索接口 + 格式化结果"**，不关心用哪家搜索后端。源码注释也写明 `never provider selection or network access`。
- 实际搜索后端由**注册进 `ctx.web` 的 provider** 决定。目前预置的 provider 是 `dsh-web-search-deepseek`（DeepSeek 的 Anthropic 兼容 Messages 接口 + 原生 `web_search_20250305` server tool），它复用了 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`，但**只共享 key，不共享 baseURL**。
- `dsh-web-search-deepseek` 的 README/代码明确写了：`This provider does NOT reuse $DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL — only the API key is shared`，并且 `The wire format and native fetch client are provider-private and do not use ctx.llm` —— 也就是说它绕过了你的 LLM 路由，直接走 DeepSeek 官方搜索接口。

## 想兼容其他模型/其他搜索后端

两条路：

1. **换搜索 provider**：`ctx.web` 支持多个 provider 注册（`web.registerSearchProvider(...)`，重名抛 `WEB_DUPLICATE_PROVIDER`）。社区或自定义插件可以实现一个走任意 LLM/任意搜索 API 的 provider（例如 `dsh-plugin-verified-search` 这类第三方增强就在做类似的事），然后在组合里替换/新增。
2. **等/求官方支持**：可以在 Discussions 里发个 Feature 建议，说明希望 `web_search` 的 provider 可配置为"走当前选中的模型路由"而不是固定 DeepSeek 官方接口。

所以：**不是写死，是默认 provider 恰好是 DeepSeek 官方搜索**；换 provider 就能兼容其他模型。

这个场景现在有一条可以直接用的社区方案，不需要把搜索绑定到当前 LLM，也不用自己重写 DSH provider：用 [pi2dsh](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh) 直接挂载 Pi 的 `@juicesharp/rpiv-web-tools`。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh@0.11.0
dsh plugin --profile web add @juicesharp/rpiv-web-tools
```

它会给 DSH 会话注册独立的 `web_search` / `web_fetch`，所以选择 OpenAI、Gemini、DeepSeek 或其他聊天模型都不影响搜索。自建 SearXNG 的配置例如：

```sh
export WEB_SEARCH_PROVIDER=searxng
export SEARXNG_URL=https://your-searxng.example.com
dsh web
```

这条不是只测了“能加载”：我们已在真实 DSH runtime 里执行过 SearXNG 搜索，也用 `web_fetch` 抓取过公开 HTTPS 页面。Pi 包保持原样，不需要全局安装 CLI、生成 bundle 或使用 `file:` 路径。

这就是 #779 / #408 那条缝：聊天可以走网关或其它模型，默认 web_search 仍打官方 DeepSeek，没官方 key 就 401。

[dsh-plugin-search](https://github.com/shinjiyu/dsh-plugin-search) 只做简化：

- 工具名还是 `web_search`
- 关掉内置 `web-search-deepseek`
- 默认零配置（Tavily keyless）

安装：

```
dsh plugin --profile web add github:shinjiyu/dsh-plugin-search
```

然后重启 dsh。不是搜索全家桶。

Repo: https://github.com/shinjiyu/dsh-plugin-search
可以的 设置 -> 插件 -> 网页搜索 这里 可以配置不同的接口地址和API key

楼上说的对：设置 → 插件 → 网页搜索 能改接口和 key 的话，优先走官方配置。

[dsh-plugin-search](https://github.com/shinjiyu/dsh-plugin-search) 只给还是 401、或不想配官方搜索 key 的人：关掉内置 `web-search-deepseek`，工具名还是 `web_search`，默认零配置。不是搜索全家桶，也不替代设置页。

```
dsh plugin --profile web add github:shinjiyu/dsh-plugin-search
```
