records.title: Make pi-ai's inferred `supportsDeveloperRole` configurable on hand-declared llm-pi-ai routes
records.body:
`CONTRIBUTING.md` says external pull requests cannot be accepted right now, so this is filed here instead. A working patch exists on a fork if it is useful; otherwise the report alone should be enough to reproduce.

## The gap

`llm-pi-ai` lets a profile configure `compat.thinkingFormat` and `compat.supportsReasoningEffort` for a hand-declared route, but not the third switch pi-ai infers the same way. In `@earendil-works/pi-ai`, `openai-completions.js:1148` computes:

```js
supportsDeveloperRole: isOpenRouterDeveloperRoleModel || (!isNonStandard && !isOpenRouter)
```

`isNonStandard` matches only a short host list (nvidia, cerebras, xai, together, chutes, deepseek.com, zai, moonshot, opencode, cloudflare, ant-ling). A private gateway is never on it, so the switch infers `true`, and `openai-completions.js:787-788` then sends the system prompt under the `developer` message role for any model whose descriptor has `reasoning`.

An OpenAI-compatible gateway whose backend accepts only `user`/`assistant` — a Bedrock-fronting corporate gateway, for one — therefore rejects **every** request with `Unexpected role "developer"` as soon as a model on that route declares any `reasoningEfforts`. The only way to keep the route usable today is `reasoningEfforts: false`, which forfeits all selectable thinking levels for a reason unrelated to what the model can do: the same gateway accepts `reasoning_effort`, and accepts it alongside function tools.

Worth noting for anyone trying to reproduce: a curl probe against such a gateway passes. The role is chosen inside pi-ai from the model's `reasoning` flag and the endpoint URL, not by any field in a hand-written request, so only an assembled run shows the failure.

## The patch

A third switch, `supportsDeveloperRole`, on `PiAiCompatProfile`, resolving on exactly the path the two existing switches use — model entry → route → installed catalog entry → pi-ai's URL-derived guess — and under the same openai-completions-only rule. `false` keeps system prompts on `system`.

The rest of pi-ai's compat surface (`supportsStore`, `maxTokensField`, …) stays auto-detected and unconfigurable, per the evidence bar in `packages/AGENTS.md`: a switch is exposed only where a private gateway's URL provably misleads the inference.

One vocabulary change comes with it. The block holds compat switches, not "reasoning-dispatch switches" — a message role is not reasoning dispatch — so the two rejection diagnostics now say `compat switches` instead of enumerating field names, and `definesCompatSwitch` collapses the condition that the model-level and route-level refusals each spelled out separately. Those two diagnostic strings change text; they are load-time only, with no wire or durable role.

Touched: `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/catalog.ts`, `src/config.ts`, `tests/catalog.spec.ts`, `tests/adapter.spec.ts`, both READMEs, regenerated `docs/config-catalog{,.zh}.md` plus i18n pairing records, and an Agent Note triplet at `.agents/notes/implemented/feature/2026-08-14-pi-ai-developer-role-compat-switch.md`.

Verification: `vitest run packages/llm/llm-pi-ai` (215 passing), 100% statements/branches/functions/lines for the package, `typecheck`, `lint`, and `doc-sync` (28/28). The adapter tests pin both wire outcomes against the mock server — pi-ai's inferred `developer` role on an unrecognized host, and `system` under `supportsDeveloperRole: false` while `reasoning_effort` still goes out — so the switch is proven not to be a no-op. Full `test:coverage` and the snapshot suite were not run: the adapter mounts dormant in shipped compositions, so `compat` is off the default path.

Real-gateway check: with the route declaring six `reasoningEfforts` levels for a reasoning model, a headless task with a bash tool call at `reasoningEffort: high` succeeded — the exact combination that previously failed on `Unexpected role "developer"`. That gateway is on a private network, so it cannot back a CI assertion and no e2e test claims it.

Branch: https://github.com/lyccol/deepseek-harness/tree/feat/pi-ai-developer-role-compat
Diff against master: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/compare/master...lyccol:feat/pi-ai-developer-role-compat

Take it, rewrite it, or ignore it — the report is the part that matters.

---

## 中文

`CONTRIBUTING.md` 写明目前不接受外部 PR,故发在这里。补丁已在 fork 上,可用则取,不可用的话仅凭上面的复现说明也足够。

**问题**:`llm-pi-ai` 允许手工声明的路由配置 `compat.thinkingFormat` 与 `compat.supportsReasoningEffort`,但 pi-ai 以同样方式推断的第三个开关不可配置。`openai-completions.js:1148` 对不在其非标准主机名单(nvidia、cerebras、xai、together、deepseek.com 等)内的主机一律推断 `supportsDeveloperRole: true`,于是 `:787-788` 会把任何具备 `reasoning` 的模型的系统提示放到 `developer` 角色下发送。私有网关永远不在名单里,因此一个与 OpenAI 兼容、但后端只允许 `user`/`assistant` 的网关(例如前置 Bedrock 的公司网关),只要路由上的模型声明了任何 `reasoningEfforts`,每次请求都会以 `Unexpected role "developer"` 被拒。当前唯一可用姿态是 `reasoningEfforts: false`——为一个与模型能力无关的原因放弃全部可选思考档位,而该网关本身既接受 `reasoning_effort`,也接受它与 function tools 同时出现。用 curl 探测会通过:角色是 pi-ai 依据模型 `reasoning` 标志与 URL 在内部选定的,只有装配完成的真实运行才暴露。

**补丁**:`PiAiCompatProfile` 增加 `supportsDeveloperRole`,解析顺序与前两个开关完全一致(模型条目 → 路由 → 已安装 catalog 条目 → pi-ai 按 URL 的猜测),同受「仅 `openai-completions`」约束;`compat` 面其余部分保持自动检测且仍不开放,符合 `packages/AGENTS.md` 的证据门槛。随之把该块措辞从「reasoning-dispatch switches」泛化为「compat switches」(消息角色不属于推理分派),两条加载期诊断不再逐个列出字段名,`definesCompatSwitch` 收拢了模型级与路由级此前各写一遍的同一条件。

按分类,这在上游应是 `kind/feature` + `area/llm`。

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

comments.body:
让推断的 supportsDeveloperRole 可配置很合理——手写 provider 路由时开发者应该能显式声明，而不是靠推断。

developer role 兼容问题我们 FAQ 记录过（#280/#614 同族：网关不认 developer role 时配 compat.supportsDeveloperRole: false）：https://github.com/Electricitysheep/dsh-handbook/blob/main/docs/faq.md

谢谢线索。顺着 FAQ 里的编号往下看之后,我得更正自己开帖时的说法——这件事社区已经有人做过,而且早于本帖,在先的工作应该记在他们名下:

- **#280**(8-13,7 赞)是这件事最早、最对题的诉求帖,同一个根因,场景比我这份更宽(火山 Coding Plan、newapi/Opencode Go,以及 DashScope 百炼官方 OpenAI 兼容端点——所以受影响的不只是私有网关,我开帖时把影响面写窄了)。本帖应视为它的补充,而不是另起一个诉求。
- **#559** 公布的 `Menger-8/deepseek-harness`(分支 `feature/third-party-gateway-compat`,8-14 00:04Z)已经把 compat 面从 2 个开关扩到 9 个,并且不止于配置:添加模型时用最小请求实测每个模型的档位、系统角色、推理方言与输出上限字段并自动写入,外加按主机名钉住实测事实的 `dsh-gateway-presets` 插件。就 `supportsDeveloperRole` 而言,本帖的补丁是其严格子集。
- `0reki/deepseek-harness-desktop` 也带这个字段,但默认值不同:手工声明的模型默认 `false`。这其实是个真问题——手工声明的路由是否还应该继承 pi-ai 按 URL 得出的猜测。本帖选的是"不改默认、必须显式声明",#559 选的是"不要猜,去实测",两者的取舍值得维护者一并看。

那本帖还剩什么:形态。它只加一个开关而非九个,理由按 `packages/AGENTS.md` 对公开配置字段的证据门槛给出(仅当私有网关的 URL 确实误导推断时才开放),诊断留在加载期,并带包内每文件 100% 覆盖、双语 README、`docs/config-catalog` 重出与 Agent Note。也就是一份按上游自己的规矩写好的最小补丁,而那两个 fork 是产品。哪种更合口味由维护者定。

另外一个善意提醒:那份 FAQ 目前写的"网关不认 developer role 时配 `compat.supportsDeveloperRole: false`"在上游还配不出效果——该字段尚未存在(在 `deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness` 里搜 `supportsDeveloperRole` 返回 0 条),#614 问"正确格式是什么"大概正是撞在这里。建议标注一下"需 fork 或等上游合入",可以少几个同类提问。

---

Correcting my own opening post: this was done in the community before I filed it, and the credit belongs upstream of this thread. #280 (2026-08-13, 7 upvotes) is the earlier and better-scoped request — its reports cover Volcano Coding Plan, newapi/Opencode Go, and DashScope's official OpenAI-compatible endpoint, so the blast radius is wider than the "private gateway" framing I used. `Menger-8/deepseek-harness` (branch `feature/third-party-gateway-compat`, announced in #559, 2026-08-14T00:04Z) already extends the compat surface from 2 switches to 9 and adds per-model endpoint probing plus a hostname-keyed presets plugin; on `supportsDeveloperRole` this patch is a strict subset of it. `0reki/deepseek-harness-desktop` carries the same field but defaults hand-declared models to `false` — a genuine design split worth deciding deliberately: keep pi-ai's URL-derived guess and require an explicit opt-out (this patch), flip the default for hand-declared routes (that fork), or stop guessing and measure (#559).

What remains here is shape: one switch rather than nine, justified against the evidence bar `packages/AGENTS.md` sets for public configuration fields, diagnostics kept at load time, with per-file 100% coverage, bilingual READMEs, a regenerated `docs/config-catalog`, and an Agent Note. Maintainers' call which shape they want.

补充一个不需要切换 DSH fork 的落地方式，适合已经有 Pi provider 插件的网关：通过 [pi2dsh](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh) 把该插件注册为 DSH 原生 LLM route，完整 `compat` 由 provider 自己的模型描述进入请求组装，不经过手写 `llm-pi-ai` 配置会丢字段的那条路径。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh@0.12.0
dsh plugin --profile web add <对应的 Pi provider 插件>
```

重启后模型进入 DSH 原生选择器；loop、session log、retry、subagent、permission 仍全部是 DSH 的。Pi 生态目前已有 Volcengine Ark、Kimi、LiteLLM 等 provider 包。

我们在 0.12.0 做了通用桥接验证：声明 `supportsDeveloperRole: false` 的 provider 最终在 wire 上发送 `system`；DSH 选择的 `high` reasoning effort 也确实进入 provider 请求。复现探针在 [`examples/gateway-compat/probe`](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/tree/main/examples/gateway-compat/probe)，不需要访问私有网关。

这和你帖里的补丁并不冲突：补丁是在修 DSH 自带配置入口；pi2dsh 提供的是另一条现在即可使用的入口。继续走 DSH settings 时，原问题仍然存在。

records.title: 图片占位（image placeholder）：文本模型配合本地 OCR 读图
records.body:
## 背景

DeepSeek 对话模型不支持图片输入。当前 dsh 在模型没有声明 `image` 输入能力时，`session.prompt` 直接拒绝图片（`MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES`），图片进不了会话。

一个常见需求因此无法实现：用 DeepSeek 这样的文本模型配合本地 OCR 工具，用户把图片拖进对话，模型通过 OCR 读出图片里的文字。

## 方案

图片保留在会话里，但发给模型的是图片对应的文字占位，OCR 工具负责把图片变成文字：

1. **准入开关**：`api-gateway` 新增 `allowImagePlaceholder`（默认 `false`）。开启后，即使当前模型不支持图片输入，图片也可以进入会话，作为 attachment 保存。
2. **占位替换**：llm 运行时在请求到达适配器之前，把消息里的 `image` block 替换成 `[image attachment <attachmentId>]` 文字。`LlmAdapter` 新增 `inputModalities()` 方法声明能力（默认 `[text, image]`；DeepSeek 适配器声明 `[text]`），声明为纯文本的适配器自动走占位替换。
3. **OCR 工具**：[dsh-tool-ocr](https://github.com/ferstar/dsh-tool-ocr) 接受 `attachment_id` 参数，从 attachment 服务读取图片字节，写入临时文件，交给本地 OCR 引擎（nbocr / PP-OCRv6）识别，返回阅读顺序文字和复核提示。

## 使用效果

- 拖图进会话后，模型看到 `[image attachment sha256:...]`，调用 `ocr { attachment_id }`，得到识别出的文字。
- 开关默认关闭，现有行为不变；不配置 OCR 工具的用户不会遇到图片被静默丢弃的情况。

## 实现与验证

实现已完成，包含测试、文档和 Agent Note：

- 核心改动：`LlmAdapter.inputModalities()`、`LlmRuntime.forAdapter()` 占位替换、`ApiProxyService.allowImagePlaceholder`。
- 验证过程：启动真实 dsh web，真实 PNG 图片成功进入会话（attachment id 写入会话日志），占位文字可以从日志重建，OCR 工具按 attachment_id 识别成功。
- 参考实现：`ferstar/deepseek-harness` 的 `feat/image-placeholder-for-text-only-adapters` 分支（[对比](https://github.com/ferstar/deepseek-harness/compare/deepseek-ai:master...feat/image-placeholder-for-text-only-adapters)）。
- 配套插件：[dsh-tool-ocr](https://github.com/ferstar/dsh-tool-ocr)（独立插件，`ocr` 工具 + nbocr 引擎）。

## 讨论点

1. 占位文字格式 `[image attachment <id>]` 是否合适？（ACP 桥接器已有同款写法）
2. 开关默认值：保持默认关闭，还是默认开启？
3. 这个功能是否值得合入核心，而不是只存在于 fork？

comments.body:
这个用户目标现在已经有一条**不改 Harness core**、从 npm 安装即可用的实现：`pi2dsh@0.11.0` 会给每个 text-only route 自动注册 `<route>-vision` 伴生 route。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh@0.11.0
```

选择模型列表里的 “+ Vision Bridge” 伴生项后，Web 贴图可以进入 durable session；发送给原文本模型前，image block 会被替换成带物化文件路径的行动提示，像本帖 `dsh-tool-ocr` 这种接受 `path` 的工具可以直接消费，像素不会进入文本模型 wire。这个“图片准入 → attachment 落盘 → 路径占位 → 原文本 route”链已经在真实 DSH Web 会话里核对过 session log。

如果希望图片先自动转成完整视觉描述再交给 DeepSeek，而不只是让 Agent 按需调用路径工具，再装 Pi 视觉插件：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @kassing/pi-vision

export VISION_BRIDGE_BASE_URL=https://openrouter.ai/api/v1
export VISION_BRIDGE_MODEL=qwen/qwen2.5-vl-72b-instruct
export VISION_BRIDGE_API_KEY=your-openrouter-key

dsh web
```

这条路线的 CLI/Web 两端都已做过真实闭环：贴图被视觉模型分析，结果作为 `pi2dsh:@kassing/pi-vision` 上下文注入，原 DeepSeek 文本模型只收文本并正确回答图片内容。

项目和可复现实例：https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/tree/main/examples/vision-bridge

replies.body:
感谢分享 `pi2dsh`。我去看了 README 和 `src/provider-adapter.ts`，这个实现是真实可跑的：通过注册 `<route>-vision` 伴生路由让图片通过准入，再在转发前把 `image` block 替换成带物化路径的文本提示，或者交给视觉模型生成描述后注入。插件层能做到这个程度，也说明 DSH 的扩展点足够强。

不过本帖方案的侧重点和它不一样，主要差异在于：

- **本帖是本地离线 OCR 路线。** 图片不需要上传到任何外部视觉模型，也不需要配置 OpenRouter 之类的 API key；OCR 在本地完成，图片不出本机。pi2dsh 的自动视觉描述路线需要外部 vision API，这是两类不同的隐私/成本/离线假设。
- **本帖想提供一个通用的 core 抽象：** 让任意声明 text-only 的 adapter 都能通过 `allowImagePlaceholder` 接收图片，并在发给模型前替换成 `[image attachment <id>]` 占位。这样模型可以调用接受 `attachment_id` 的本地 OCR 工具（例如 `dsh-tool-ocr`），而不是依赖某个特定桥的伴生路由。
- **用户操作上也有差别：** pi2dsh 需要手动选择 `<route>-vision` 伴生项；本帖方案在原文本模型路由上直接拖图即可，开关默认关闭，不改变现有行为。

我的看法是两者可以共存：pi2dsh 对已经在用 Pi 生态、并且愿意接外部视觉模型的用户有价值；本帖 core 方案则更适合想要纯本地、离线、不依赖 LLM API，并且希望 DSH 本身具备通用图片占位能力的场景。如果以后 core 有了 `inputModalities()` 这套机制，pi2dsh 也可以基于它简化自己的实现。

records.title: [Idea] Long-term memory capability seam (dsh-memory + TencentDB Agent Memory provider + tools)
records.body:
## What

A new optional capability seam — `ctx.memory` — that lets a dsh agent explicitly save notes, recall them, and read a standing long-term profile, backed by [TencentDB Agent Memory](https://github.com/TencentCloud/TencentDB-Agent-Memory).

Three packages, mirroring `dsh-web`'s existing Service Definition / Provider / Consumer split:

- **`@deepseek-ai/dsh-memory`** — the `ctx.memory` Service Definition. One provider registry (unlike `dsh-web`'s independent search/fetch registries — `save`/`search`/`readProfile` are three faces of one coherent memory backend, not independently swappable operations), execution-time provider selection with the same configured/auto-select/ambiguous rules as `dsh-web`, and a `MemoryError` taxonomy.
- **`@deepseek-ai/dsh-memory-tencentdb`** — a provider backed by the real, zero-dependency `@tencentdb-agent-memory/memory-sdk-ts-v2` client (v3 strict-isolation API). `save()` → `POST /v3/conversation/add` (L0), `search()` → `POST /v3/atomic/search` (L1 semantic recall), `readProfile()` → `POST /v3/core/read` (L3 persona).
- **`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-memory`** — the model-facing `memory_save` / `memory_search` / `memory_read_profile` tools.

## Design choice: explicit tool calls, not automatic context injection

TencentDB Agent Memory's own Claude Code integration works as a **reverse LLM-API proxy** — it reroutes `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` through a local proxy that auto-injects L2/L3 memory into every system prompt and uses a synthetic `AskUserQuestion` tool call at session start to pick Team/Agent/Task. That's a clean fit for Claude Code specifically, but it doesn't map onto dsh's architecture: dsh already owns its own LLM request assembly and system-prompt composition per session, and there's no dsh-side equivalent of "reroute the model endpoint through a middlebox."

So this integration instead treats memory as an ordinary **capability seam + tool**, the same shape as `dsh-web`: the agent decides when to save/recall, same as it decides when to search the web. No automatic system-prompt injection, no proxy, no session-init picker. This is also just less invasive — it doesn't touch `agent-loop` or `system-prompt` composition internals, and the seam is fully optional (a deployment that doesn't compose a memory provider simply doesn't have the tools do anything at execution time — they still register but fail with a structured `MemoryError` code).

## Testing

Per project policy for a fresh provider, unit and real-composition tests run against a **mocked SDK client** — I don't have a running TencentDB Agent Memory deployment (it's a 3-container Docker stack needing an LLM key) to verify end-to-end against. 72 new tests, all passing. Full workspace `typecheck`, `lint`, `build`, and `doc-sync` (28/28 gates, including the bilingual pairing and generated-catalog gates) are green. The existing repo test suite passes in full except one pre-existing, confirmed-flaky, unrelated subprocess test (passes cleanly in isolation).

One real thing worth flagging: while integrating I discovered the SDK's *published* npm version (`1.0.0-beta.1`) has a materially different export surface than what's on the `feat/server_team` branch's source — the v3 strict-isolation client is exported as `V3MemoryClient`, not the bare `MemoryClient` (that name is the older v2 client), and there's no `ParamError` class in the published version (client-side validation throws a plain `Error`). The provider is built against what's actually published, not the docs.

## Known limitations (documented in each package's README)

- No delete/update operations yet — the seam starts narrow (write/recall/profile-read) and widens only when a real consumer needs the richer L0–L3 CRUD the SDK exposes.
- The SDK's transport doesn't accept an `AbortSignal`, so an in-flight request can't be cancelled mid-flight — only an already-aborted signal is honored (fails fast before the call).
- Not field-verified against a live deployment (see Testing above).

## Links

Per `CONTRIBUTING.md`, not opening a PR — posting here instead, same as [the earlier web-composer discussion](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1614).

**Fork branch:** https://github.com/raktim-mondol/deepseek-harness/tree/feature/tencentdb-memory-integration
**Diff:** https://github.com/raktim-mondol/deepseek-harness/compare/master...raktim-mondol:deepseek-harness:feature/tencentdb-memory-integration

Happy to expand on the design tradeoffs, split the seam into a separate proposal from the concrete provider, or adjust the tool surface if this is a direction the team is interested in.

comments.body:
This is a good fit for an optional capability seam, and the decision not to put an opaque reverse proxy in the model path is especially sound. I would tighten five contracts before treating the interface as stable.

### 1. Isolation identity must not be model-controlled

The provider call needs an execution-owned scope such as tenant / principal / agent / workspace / session. Those identifiers should come from the host context, not from `memory_save` or `memory_search` arguments. Otherwise a prompt-injected model can ask the tool to search another user or agent namespace.

A useful invariant is:

```
model chooses: query, note, recall intent
host chooses: tenant, principal, agent, workspace, provider route
```

The seam can remain provider-neutral, but the scope needs to be part of its contract from v1. Adding it later will be a breaking change.

### 2. Do not expose tools that can only fail

> no provider simply means the tools register and fail at execution time

That makes the advertised tool surface disagree with the assembled runtime. It costs context and teaches the model to call an unavailable capability. Prefer conditional tool registration when `ctx.memory` has no usable provider, or expose an availability projection that the tool bundle uses during composition. A structured `MemoryError` is still required for runtime loss after registration, but it should not be normal discovery behavior.

### 3. Save needs idempotency and an explicit effect contract

A memory write is an external, durable effect. Agent-loop retry, transport ambiguity, or session resume can execute the same logical save more than once. The provider contract should accept an idempotency key owned by the harness—ideally derived from the durable tool-call/session event identity—not generated by the model.

Also declare whether `save` requires approval and which audit event proves it committed. “Request timed out” is not equivalent to “write did not happen.”

### 4. A timeout wrapper does not cancel the write

Because the SDK has no `AbortSignal`, `Promise.race` can bound the agent’s wait but cannot stop the underlying request. A late `save` may still commit after DSH reports timeout. That produces an unknown outcome, not a clean failure. I would give writes a distinct error such as `OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`, pair it with the idempotency key, and document reconciliation/retry behavior. Reads can use an ordinary timeout classification.

### 5. Recalled memory is untrusted content with provenance

L1/L3 output can contain stale instructions, prompt injection, or data written by another workflow. Return typed records with source, scope, timestamps, stable IDs, and confidence—not only concatenated text. Keep result-count and byte/token caps in the provider/tool boundary. The system prompt should state that recalled text is evidence/data, never a higher-priority instruction.

A narrow v1 surface is still the right choice. I would keep `save/search/readProfile`, but make scope, provenance, idempotency, effect policy, and unknown-outcome semantics explicit before adding delete/update. Those five decisions determine whether providers remain interchangeable and whether the memory seam is safe to compose into multiple agent products.

I turned this review into a reusable, source-backed checklist that also separates Session replay, compaction, Skills, and cross-session memory: [handbook PR #12](https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/pull/12). Corrections against the proposed seam or current DSH Session/MCP behavior are welcome there.

A useful implementation data point for this seam: DSH can already run an existing Pi memory package unchanged through the public plugin path.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh@0.11.0
dsh plugin --profile web add pi-hermes-memory
```

We verified the important persistence boundary on a real DSH runtime: process A wrote with `memory_add`; a fresh process B recovered it with `memory_search`. The package also exposes add/replace/remove/search, global/project stores, session search, and on-demand retrieval. No DSH source fork or LLM reverse proxy is involved: https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh

That does not replace the proposed provider-neutral `ctx.memory` contract, but it gives the RFC a deployable comparison point: explicit memory tools and cross-session persistence work today, while the native seam can focus on the harder host-owned contracts already raised here—scope identity, provenance, idempotency, approval/effect semantics, and unknown outcomes.

records.title: [Feature Request] 支持在非官方 DeepSeek 风格 OpenAI 兼容网关上选择思考挡位 / Support reasoning-effort selection on non-official DeepSeek-style OpenAI-compatible gateways
records.body:
## 需求背景 / Motivation

我们在一个非官方的 OpenAI 兼容网关上使用 DSH。该网关的模型遵循 DeepSeek
语义，并接受 `reasoning_effort` 挡位（off / high / max）。我们希望通过现有
配置面（模型条目上的 `reasoningEfforts` 声明、`agent-default-model` 中的
`reasoningEffort` 选择）在非官方网关上按模型、按会话选择思考挡位。目前这条
链路无法端到端工作——请求还没到达模型就失败了。

We run DSH against a non-official OpenAI-compatible gateway whose models
follow DeepSeek semantics and accept `reasoning_effort` levels (off / high /
max). We want to select the reasoning effort per model and per session, using
the existing configuration surface (`reasoningEfforts` on model entries and
`reasoningEffort` in `agent-default-model`). On such a gateway this currently
does not work end to end — every request fails before reaching the model.

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    internal:
      api: openai-completions
      baseURL: https://example.internal/v1   # DeepSeek-style gateway
      compat:
        thinkingFormat: deepseek
      models:
        - id: model-x
          reasoningEfforts:
            off:
            high: high
            max: max
agent-default-model:
  provider: internal
  model: model-x
  reasoningEffort: high
```

## 拦路问题 / Blocking issue

一旦模型声明思考挡位，pi-ai 就会用 OpenAI 的 `developer` 角色发送 system
prompt。DeepSeek 风格的端点只接受 `system` / `user` / `assistant` / `tool`
四种角色，因此网关对每个请求都返回 `400 messages[0].role: unknown variant
'developer'`。手工声明的路由目前无法保持 `system` 角色。

As soon as a model advertises reasoning efforts, pi-ai sends the system
prompt with the OpenAI `developer` role. DeepSeek-style endpoints only accept
`system` / `user` / `assistant` / `tool`, so the gateway rejects every request
with `400 messages[0].role: unknown variant 'developer'`. Hand-declared routes
currently have no way to keep the `system` role.

## 建议方案 / Proposed fix

在 route 级和 model 级的 compat 配置中增加 `supportsDeveloperRole`（回退顺序：
目录条目 → baseURL 推断），并透传到 `resolveModelCompat`——与现有
`supportsReasoningEffort` 开关完全对称：

Add `supportsDeveloperRole` to the route- and model-level compat profile
(falling back to the installed catalog entry, then pi-ai's baseURL-derived
guess), carried through `resolveModelCompat` — symmetric with the existing
`supportsReasoningEffort` switch:

```yaml
compat:
  thinkingFormat: deepseek
  supportsDeveloperRole: false   # keep role 'system' on DeepSeek-style endpoints
```

两个开关配合后，非官方 DeepSeek 风格网关上的思考挡位选择即可完整可用。
已有可运行的实现（约 16 行改动，补丁见附件），并已在生产环境的内网
DeepSeek 风格网关上验证三个挡位全部可用。

Together the two switches make reasoning-effort selection fully functional on
non-official DeepSeek-style gateways. A working implementation exists
(~16-line diff, patch attached) and has been verified in production against an
internal DeepSeek-style gateway with all three effort levels.
[llm-pi-ai-supports-developer-role.patch](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31092834/llm-pi-ai-supports-developer-role.patch)

comments.body: 话说怎么不开放Issues啊，多少人等着提交呢

这个端到端拦路现在可以通过另一条 provider route 绕开，不需要禁用 reasoning，也不需要给网关加 role rewrite。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh
dsh plugin --profile web add <对应网关的 Pi provider 包>
```

[pi2dsh](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh) 把自带 transport 的 Pi provider 注册为 DSH 原生 LLM adapter。provider 的 `thinkingLevelMap` 会变成模型选择器里的档位，用户选中的 effort 会进入它自己的 stream；`compat.supportsDeveloperRole: false` 也由同一份模型描述消费，不经过 DSH settings 白名单。

这三件事都做了实际 wire 验证：档位可选、High 真下传、system prompt 发成 `system`。原 settings 路径仍然有原帖所述缺口。

如果不想等 DSH 内置 pi-ai catalog 升级，可以直接使用独立 Provider 的实时版本：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh
```

records.title: Docs suggestion: a "Migrating from Claude Code" guide (most of it is already free)
records.body:
A large share of the people trying DSH this week come from Claude Code, and the single most common question shape in discussions is some form of "how do I bring my setup over". The pleasant surprise is that DSH already did most of the work, CLAUDE.md is a default instruction candidate, SKILL.md loads as is, mcp__server__tool names are identical, and dsh-hooks-claude-code runs existing hooks configs unchanged. But none of that is discoverable in one place in the docs, people find it out by reading source or by accident.

Suggestion, a short "Migrating from Claude Code" page under docs/user/guide covering, per asset type, what is native, what needs one manual step, and what has no equivalent (sessions, slash commands, permission allowlists). Since external PRs are not accepted right now, offering research instead of a patch. We measured every asset type against the rc.6 source and published it as a compatibility matrix, feel free to lift any of it into official docs, no attribution needed:

https://github.com/sjh9714/dsh-movein/blob/main/docs/compat.md

Community tooling already covers the automatable parts (dsh-chat-import for conversation history, dsh-movein for config/skills/MCP/hooks), the docs gap is the map itself.

中文：建议在官方文档加一页「从 Claude Code 迁移」。DSH 其实已经原生消化了大半（CLAUDE.md 默认读取、SKILL.md 原样兼容、MCP 工具名一致、hooks 有官方桥），但这些散落在源码里，没有一处能看全。我们按 rc.6 源码逐项实测整理了对照表（上面链接，含中文摘要），官方文档随意取用，无需署名。


The repository now includes real DSH-loop examples for vision, Codex image generation/editing, side conversations, MCP, subagents, provider routes and cross-process memory. records.title: 💡 Proposal: Configurable base URL for 'web_search' endpoint to support custom API proxies
records.body:
Hi DeepSeek Team,

Currently, the default ' web_search'  plugin routes requests strictly to the official endpoint. When running ' dsh web' behind custom enterprise gateways or self-hosted API proxies, requests to this service fail with 403/authentication errors.

Suggested improvement:
Allow ' web_search'  to read custom endpoint configurations from the environment or settings file (e.g., 'DSH_WEB_SEARCH_ENDPOINT'  or via the provider config UI).

If set, the search plugin would route calls to the custom proxy instead of hardcoding the default endpoint, making 'deepseek-harness'  significantly easier to deploy in enterprise environments.

thanks

comments.body:
这条和 #408 / #779 是同一条缝：搜索端点不跟聊天走。

现在不用等官方改配置也能用：装 [dsh-plugin-search](https://github.com/shinjiyu/dsh-plugin-search)，会关掉内置 `web-search-deepseek`，`web_search` 工具名不变，默认零配置。

```
dsh plugin --profile web add github:shinjiyu/dsh-plugin-search
```

介绍帖：https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1715

这个企业部署场景可以直接换一个 `web_search` 实现，不必让搜索继续绑定官方端点：Pi 生态的 [`@juicesharp/rpiv-web-tools`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@juicesharp/rpiv-web-tools) 可通过 [pi2dsh](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh) 原包运行在 DSH。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh@0.11.0
dsh plugin --profile web add @juicesharp/rpiv-web-tools
```

装完重启 `dsh`。插件同时提供 `web_search` 和 `web_fetch`，可选 Brave、Tavily、Serper、Exa、You.com、Jina、Firecrawl、Perplexity，也支持企业自建 **SearXNG** 或本机/内网 **Ollama**。例如：

```sh
export WEB_SEARCH_PROVIDER=searxng
export SEARXNG_URL=https://search.example.internal
dsh web
```

`web_fetch` 自带 private/loopback/metadata 地址拦截；长页面会把全文写入临时文件供模型按需读取，避免一次塞满上下文。

这条链路已经在真实 DSH runtime 执行过搜索和网页全文抓取，不只是“插件能加载”；证据在 [runtime results](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/blob/main/community/runtime-results.json)。对原帖“搜索必须经过企业网关/自托管代理”的需求，现在即可直接使用。

records.title: 主Agent与子Agent调用模型不一致问题
records.body: 当在一个会话中首先使用Deepseek官方api模型对话，后换为自定义模型后，有概率导致主Agent切换为自定义模型但子Agent仍使用官方模型，导致api扣费。

comments.body:
如果目标是先避免“主 Agent 已切换、子 Agent 还偷偷走旧的官方模型”，现在可以用 Pi 的子代理实现绕开这条原生继承缺口：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh@0.11.0
dsh plugin --profile web add @tintinweb/pi-subagents
```

这个包注册 `Agent` 工具。默认子代理的 `model` 是 **inherit parent**；通过 pi2dsh 创建时，Pi 的 `createAgentSession` 会被映射成 DSH 真正的 `ctx.agents` child，并把创建当刻父会话的 provider/model 传进 child 的 `agentOptions`，不是在插件里另起一个假的模型循环。

如果希望完全消除隐式继承，也可以给某类子代理显式钉模型：

```md
---
model: my-gateway/glm-5.3
tools: read, grep, find
---

你是只读代码检索子代理。
```

保存到项目的 `.pi/agents/researcher.md` 后，主 Agent 调用：

```text
Agent({ subagent_type: "researcher", prompt: "检查这个问题" })
```

这样“跟随父模型”和“每类子代理固定模型”都可控。我们已验证这不是只挂载了工具名：`@tintinweb/pi-subagents` 通过 pi2dsh 启动的是带独立 durable session 的真实 DSH child agent，模型请求走 DSH 原生 llm route。实现说明见 [pi2dsh 的 subagent bridge](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh#pi-host-abi-coverage)。

records.title: [Idea] Tool-specific model routing (like OpenClaw's imageModel)
records.body:
# Feature Request: Tool-Specific Model Routing (like OpenClaw's imageModel)

## Problem Statement

Currently DSH only supports one default model per Agent session (via `settings.yaml`'s `agent-default-model` field). When executing certain tools (like `read_image`), if the main model doesn't support the required input modality (e.g., images), the tool call fails.

## Current Behavior

```yaml
# Current settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: angnes-ai
  model: agnes-2.0-flash  # Text-only model
```

Problem: When Agent needs to call `read_image` tool, since `agnes-2.0-flash` doesn't support image input, the tool call fails with error:
```
Error: cannot read "image.png" as an image: model "agnes-2.0-flash" does not declare image input
```

## Proposed Solution

Reference [OpenClaw](https://github.com/nicholetti/openclaw)'s dual-model configuration, introduce **tool-specific model routing** in DSH:

```yaml
# Proposed new config format
agent-default-model:
  provider: angnes-ai
  model: agnes-2.0-flash       # Main model: for general conversation
  imageModel:                  # Image-specific model
    provider: angnes-ai
    model: agnes-image-2.1-flash
  # Future extensions for other tool models
  # codeModel: ...
  # searchModel: ...
```

## Benefits

1. **Cost Optimization**: Use low-cost model for daily conversations, switch to vision model only when image understanding is needed
2. **Performance**: Lightweight models handle general tasks faster
3. **Flexibility**: Reserve extension space for future tools (code generation, search, etc.)
4. **User-friendly**: No need to manually switch models, system routes automatically

## Reference Implementation (OpenClaw)

OpenClaw's similar configuration:

```json
{
  "agents": {
    "defaults": {
      "model": {
        "primary": "shangtangrrx/deepseek-v4-flash",
        "fallbacks": ["agnesai/agnes-2.0-flash"]
      },
      "imageModel": {
        "primary": "shangtangrrx/sensenova-6.7-flash-lite",
        "fallbacks": ["mdapi/Qwen/Qwen3.5-27B"]
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Implementation Suggestions

1. **Config Parsing**: Parse `imageModel` field in `dsh-agent-loop` or `dsh-llm-pi-ai`
2. **Model Routing**: When tool call detects image input needed, automatically switch to `imageModel` configured model
3. **Fallback Mechanism**: If `imageModel` request fails, fallback to main model (if supported) or return clear error
4. **Backward Compatibility**: Behavior remains unchanged when `imageModel` is not configured

## Related Files to Modify

- `settings.yaml` schema definition
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-loop` - Model selection logic
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` - Multi-model routing
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-models` - UI configuration interface

## Environment Details

- DSH Version: 0.1.0-rc.6
- Provider: angnes-ai (https://apihub.agnes-ai.cn/v1)
- Available Models:
  - `agnes-2.0-flash` (text only)
  - `agnes-image-2.0-flash` (text + image)
  - `agnes-image-2.1-flash` (text + image)
  - `agnes-2.5-pro` (text only)

comments.body:
原帖里的 `imageModel` 场景现在可以直接跑，不需要先等 DSH core 增加通用 tool router：Pi 生态的 [`pi-vision-tool`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/pi-vision-tool) 已经把“主模型 + 独立视觉模型”做成了一个 `describe_image` 工具，[pi2dsh](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh) 可以把它原包挂进 DSH。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh@0.11.0
dsh plugin --profile web add pi-vision-tool
```

如果你的 `angnes-ai / agnes-image-2.1-flash` 已经作为 DSH 官方 `llm-pi-ai` route 配好，只需在启动 Web 前指定视觉路由：

```sh
export PI_VISION_PROVIDER=angnes-ai
export PI_VISION_MODEL=agnes-image-2.1-flash
dsh web
```

这时会形成原帖想要的分工：

- 会话主模型仍然是便宜、快速的 `agnes-2.0-flash`；
- 只有 Agent 调用 `describe_image` 时，图片和针对该图的 prompt 才会送到 `agnes-image-2.1-flash`；
- 视觉模型返回文字工具结果，主模型继续完成任务；
- Agent 每次调用还可以选择压缩、视觉提示词和推理深度，不需要整段会话切模型。

pi2dsh 同时会给纯文本 route 自动生成 **+ Vision Bridge** 伴生分组，所以 Web 粘贴的图片能先物化成路径再交给 `describe_image`，不会卡在原帖的图片准入错误上。

我们已经用真实 DSH Web loop 跑通这条双模型链路；完整的 route 配置、截图和另一种“发图即自动分析”的实现见 [#2040](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2040)。

records.title: [Feature Request] 历史消息含图片时，允许切换到纯文本模型 / Allow switching image-containing sessions to text-only models
records.body: Hi DeepSeek Harness 团队，使用过程中发现一个与模型切换有关的问题，想在这里反馈一下。 ## 问题描述 在历史消息中包含图片的会话里，尝试切换到不支持图片输入的模型时，操作会被直接拒绝，无法完成切换。 ## 复现步骤 1. 在会话中发送一张图片。 2. 图片相关问题处理完毕后，尝试切换到 DeepSeek V4 Flash 等不支持图片输入的模型。 3. 切换被拒绝，报错： `Model "deepseek-v4-flash" does not accept image input, but this session already contains images; select an image-capable model.` ## 推测的原因 检查相关代码后发现，切换模型时，`selectModel` 会检查当前会话中是否还有图片，以及目标模型是否支持图片输入。如果会话中有图片，而目标模型明确不支持，就会直接报错并拒绝切换。 DSH 使用的底层依赖中已有图片降级函数 `downgradeUnsupportedImages`。当模型不支持图片时，它可以把历史消息中的图片替换成文字占位符。这个机制本来可以用来处理上述场景，但目前没有被用于模型切换：模型选择阶段的检查更早生效，直接阻止了切换。 ## 期望的效果与建议 有些任务必须借助图片才能说明清楚，这时可以先使用视觉模型；图片相关的问题处理完以后，如果后续不再需要图片，用户可能希望切换到性价比更高的纯文本模型，例如 DeepSeek V4 Flash。 建议允许用户切换到纯文本模型，可以复用现有的 downgradeUnsupportedImages 机制，也可以采用其他合适的处理方式。 至于是否需要用户确认，可以在交互上增加提示或确认框，明确告知用户：目标模型不支持图片，历史图片会被替换成文字占位符；确认后再完成切换。 ## 运行环境 - `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6` - Web UI - Windows ## 截图 见附图。 感谢阅读，希望这个建议能对后续体验改进有所帮助。 --- ## English Version ### Allow switching image-containing sessions to text-only models via the existing image downgrade capability Hi DeepSeek Harness team, I noticed an issue while switching models and would like to share it here. #### Description When a session contains images in its message history, switching to a model that does not support image input is rejected. #### Steps to reproduce 1. Send an image in a session. 2. After the image-related task is complete, try to switch to a model that does not support image input, such as DeepSeek V4 Flash. 3. The switch is rejected with the following error: `Model "deepseek-v4-flash" does not accept image input, but this session already contains images; select an image-capable model.` #### Possible cause After checking the relevant code, I found that `selectModel` checks whether the current session still contains images and whether the target model supports image input. If the session contains images and the target model explicitly does not support them, the switch is rejected immediately. The underlying dependency used by DSH already has an image downgrade function named `downgradeUnsupportedImages`. When a model does not support images, this function can replace images in the message history with text placeholders. This existing mechanism could be used for the scenario above, but it is currently not applied during model switching: the earlier model-selection check blocks the switch first. #### Expected behavior and suggestion Some tasks require a vision model because images are necessary to explain the problem. After the image-related part is complete, if images are no longer needed, users may want to switch to a more cost-effective text-only model, such as DeepSeek V4 Flash. It would be helpful to allow users to switch to a text-only model, either by reusing the existing downgradeUnsupportedImages mechanism or through another suitable approach. If confirmation is considered necessary, the UI could show a warning or confirmation dialog explaining that the target model does not support images and that historical images will be replaced with text placeholders before completing the switch. #### Environment - `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6` - Web UI - Windows #### Screenshot See the screenshot above. Thank you for taking the time to review this feedback.

comments.body:
技术原因很直接：会话里已存在的 image content block 要求当前模型具备视觉能力；切成纯文本模型后，历史消息里的图片块会变成该模型不支持的输入，provider 直接报错。

现在的可行路径：

1. **新会话 + 引用文件**：开新会话切文本模型，用 @file / 附件引用代替图片块（社区插件 dsh-at-file 就是这个模式），历史图片不再进上下文。
2. **压缩后再切**：先触发一次 compaction，把带图的会话压成文本摘要，再切文本模型——摘要里不再有图片块。
3. **继续用视觉模型但降低视觉开销**：如果只是偶尔看图，保留视觉模型但把图片引用改成"按需加载"，而不是每轮都带。

值得做的官方改进：**模型切换时检测历史图片块并给出选项**（"切换到纯文本模型将剥离 N 个图片块，历史图片将以附件引用保留，确认？"），剥离而不是报错。这个交互成本很低，PR 通道开了可以提。

replies.body:
感谢佬的分析和回复！

关于 **压缩后再切** 这个方案有个疑问：会话历史里原本是没有存储任何图片文字描述的。视觉模型当时看过图片，但那只是它自己内部的理解过程，并不会显式地把描述存下来。所以 compaction 要生成包含图片信息的摘要，就必须临时调用一次视觉模型，这是一次额外的 API 调用，多出了时间和费用成本，作为切换模型的前置步骤代价有点高。

另外，看了一下 DSH 内部的实现，在 `transform-messages.js` 里有一套 `downgradeUnsupportedImages` 机制，看起来是用于处理某些异常情况——当文本模型在运行过程中意外遇到图片内容时，自动将图片块替换为占位文字。不知道这套机制是否可以引入到 `selectModel` 这里复用？如果可行的话，切换时在本地直接处理历史图片块，成本几乎为零，同时给用户一个确认提示告知图片将被忽略，这样体验会更自然一些。

你提的几个绕过方案都很有参考价值，不过感觉如果能在切换流程本身上做优化，对用户来说可能会更顺畅一点，也更符合 DSH 灵活切换的使用方式。

comments.body:
这个切换场景现在有一个不改 DeepSeek Harness core 的可用解法：[`pi2dsh@0.11.0`](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh) 会给每条 text-only route 自动注册同模型目录的 `<route>-vision` 伴生路由。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh@0.11.0
```

重启后，模型选择器里会出现 **DeepSeek + Vision Bridge** 分组。需要从带图历史切到 `deepseek-v4-flash` 时，不选原始 DeepSeek 分组里的 Flash，而选伴生分组里的同一个 Flash：

- 伴生模型对 Harness 目录声明可接收 image，因此 `selectModel` 的历史图片检查可以通过；
- 真正调用模型前，它会递归扫描本次请求的**完整消息历史**，把 image block（包括嵌套 tool-result 里的图片）替换成文字标记；能物化附件时标记里带本地文件路径；
- 然后把纯文本消息转发给原始 `deepseek-v4-flash` route，所以像素不会进入 DeepSeek 文本 adapter，provider/model 也没有被伪装成另一套传输。

如果后续还要继续理解新图片，可再装 `@kassing/pi-vision` 自动转描述，或 `pi-vision-tool` 让 Agent 按需调用；如果像原帖所说“图片阶段已经处理完”，只装 pi2dsh、切伴生分组就能完成降级切换。

真实 Web 复现、公开视觉端点配置和截图：https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/tree/main/examples/vision-bridge

更新：8 月 21 日发布的 `v0.1.1-rc.2` 已经实现了本帖建议的核心功能：允许通过请求期临时降级，将带图历史会话切换到纯文本模型。纯文本请求会把历史图片临时替换为文字占位符；切回视觉模型后，原始图片仍会重新进入请求。

继续测试时发现两个可以优化的地方：图片被降级时用户没有明确感知；切回视觉模型后，当前模型也可能被上一轮纯文本模型的回答带偏。相关设计、对比截图和参考实现整理在新的 Discussion：<(https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/4188)>

records.title: 【建议】纯文本模型收到图片时提供“落盘+文字标记”回退，便于子 Agent / 视觉脚本接管
records.body:
**背景**

当会话选中的模型不支持图片输入（`inputModalities` 不含 `image`，例如 `deepseek-v4-flash`）时，web 通道会在消息准入层直接拒绝图片消息（`MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES`），图片不会落盘，Agent 完全拿不到任何信息。于是“文本主模型 + 外部视觉能力（视觉脚本 / 视觉子 Agent）”的组合只能自己绕路（比如让用户把图片放进工作区目录，再手动触发）。

**已有的参照实现**

同一生态里的 `deepseek-harness-qqbot` 插件在 `imageInputMode: auto` 下，遇到纯文本模型并不会丢弃图片：它先把图片存为 Harness attachment，再把消息降级为文字标记（`Stored as Harness attachment sha256:...`）。Agent 拿到 attachmentId 后可以自行调用视觉工具处理。这个回退模式很合理，建议 web 通道（或全局）提供等价策略。

**具体建议**

1. 给准入层加一个可配置的回退策略（例如 `imageFallback: "store-and-annotate"`，可通过 settings 开关，默认可考虑开启）：
   - 纯文本模型 + 图片消息 → 不拒绝，照常走 `durablePromptContent` 落盘；
   - 图片块替换为文字标记（含 attachmentId、文件名、媒体类型，最好附带可解析的本地路径）；
   - 视觉模型的行为完全不变。
   这基本就是把 qqbot 插件 inbound 的 fallback 逻辑上移到 web 网关（`dsh-host-apiproxy` 的 `prompt`/`admit` 处理），改动很小，我们本地对照源码评估约十几行。
2. （可选、更通用）暴露一个“消息入站预处理”的 cordis 钩子/服务：插件可在消息进入 agent inbox 前把图片块替换为文字描述（自行调用视觉 API，或让子 Agent 用视觉模型读取）。目前 `dsh-agent` 层没有这个挂点，纯插件无法绕过 web 准入层。

**用例**

主模型用 DeepSeek 文本模型，另配一个视觉脚本（如调用 Gemini 的 vision API）或给子 Agent 配置视觉 provider（`dsh-tool-subagent` 的 `agentOptions.provider/model` 已支持）：用户在 web 直接发图 → 落盘 + 标记 → 主 Agent 触发子 Agent / 脚本读图 → 基于描述作答。这个工作流我们已在本地验证可行，只差网关这一扇门。

comments.body: 顶

这扇门确实在准入层：纯文本模型（如 Flash）贴图会被 `MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES` 直接拒，图不落盘，后面的视觉脚本 / 子 Agent 都接不到。

官方若把 `imageFallback: store-and-annotate` 收进 web 网关最好。在那之前，插件侧可以先把门打开——只做受理：贴图落成本地路径 / attachment，主模型仍是纯文本，不把 `input: [text, image]` 当成官方 chat-completions 已解锁，也不是 `vision_*` / `read_image` 工具箱。

```
dsh plugin --profile web add github:shinjiyu/dsh-plugin-multimodal
```

装完要重启 `dsh web`。说明在 https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1709

这个场景现在也有一条已经跑通的插件方案，而且不只做到“落盘+标记”：[`pi2dsh@0.11.0`](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh) 会为每条纯文本模型路由自动注册独立的 `<route>-vision` 伴生路由，在伴生路由上完成图片准入、附件物化和发往文本 adapter 前的图片块剥离，不修改原始 DeepSeek 路由的能力声明。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh@0.11.0
dsh plugin --profile web add @kassing/pi-vision
```

重启后在模型选择器里选择 **DeepSeek + Vision Bridge** 分组，Web 可以直接粘贴图片。后续有两种完整链路：

1. `@kassing/pi-vision` 在 `before_agent_start` 自动调用配置的视觉模型，把识图结果作为 DSH context injection 注入，纯文本 DeepSeek 直接基于描述回答；
2. 安装 `pi-vision-tool` 时，Agent 按需调用 `describe_image`；没有这两个包时，已有的 MCP/skill/script 只要能读文件路径，也能接到物化后的图片路径。

我们已经在真实 DSH Web loop 验证过：粘贴蓝色测试图 → 自动视觉分析注入 → `deepseek-v4-flash` 一轮、零工具直答 `blue`。安装、公开视觉端点配置和截图都在 [完整演示 #2040](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2040)。

所以这条建议里的用户工作流目前可以不改 core 先完整使用；core 将来提供统一入站钩子，插件实现会更薄。

感谢各位指路，来更新一下这条建议的落地情况：

我们已经按 `dsh-vision-proxy`（Flyvhidbwo）的方案跑通了：`deepseek-vision` 伴生路由设为默认，DeepSeek 负责全部文字推理，图片经 OpenAI 兼容端点转写后合并进对话。实测 web 直发图、转写、作答全链路正常，配置几分钟完成。

说实话有点过意不去——两位作者亲自来指路，两位的成果我们却没有实际用上。但这纯属时间上的巧合：动手安装时我们先看到了 dsh-vision-proxy 的 README，装完验证通过就留了下来，并不是把各家方案摆在一起比较之后的取舍，更不是两位方案有什么不足。

两位的方案我其实都仔细读过：
- `dsh-plugin-multimodal` 零运行时依赖、代码极简克制，在 adapter 层把整件事收敛得干净利落；
- `pi2dsh` 不改动原路由的能力声明，还把 Pi 生态的兼容层做成了完整体系，注入式识图和按需工具两条链路都配了完整演示，工程深度明显更深。

社区里三条路线并存，各自在适配层、伴生路由、桥接层找了不同的切入点，恰好都落在同一个问题上——图片入站缺少统一的预处理挂点。如果 core 将来提供官方 ingress hook，这类插件都能简化不少。再次感谢两位，也期待官方早点把这扇门开进 core。

records.title: Bug Report: Subagent 未正确继承父 Agent 的模型配置
records.body:
问题描述
当主 Agent 使用了非默认模型（如通过 agent-default-model 配置或运行时切换模型）时，通过 subagent / subagent_fork 工具创建的子 Agent 没有正确继承该模型配置。子 Agent 可能使用错误的默认模型，或者因 provider/model 为空导致 LLM 调用失败（返回 0 token / contextWindow 不一致）。

影响范围
所有通过 spawn 或 fork provider 创建的子 Agent
显式触发场景：用户通过 UI 切换模型后创建子 Agent
隐式触发场景：创建主 Agent 时 agentOptions 未设置 provider/model（依赖 agent-default-model 或 agent/request waterfall 运行时补全）
根因分析
问题涉及两个层面的缺陷：

1. 代码层面：resolveChildAgentOptions 仅读取 parent.options 快照
文件：packages/subagent/subagent/src/child-agent.ts (第 68-83 行)

export function resolveChildAgentOptions(
  parent: Agent,
  requested: AgentOptions | undefined,
  childDepth: number,
): AgentOptions {
  const parentProvider = parent.options.provider
  const parentModel = parent.options.model
  const parentMaxTokens = parent.options.maxTokens
  return {
    ...parentProvider !== undefined ? { provider: parentProvider } : {},
    ...parentModel !== undefined ? { model: parentModel } : {},
    ...parentMaxTokens !== undefined ? { maxTokens: parentMaxTokens } : {},
    ...requested,
    subagentDepth: childDepth,
  }
}

parent.options 是 ReactLoopAgent 构造函数中保存的不可变快照（agent.ts:80-84），它只在 Agent 创建时设置一次，后续不会更新。

然而，主 Agent 的实际运行模型可能在以下两种情况下与 parent.options 不一致：

运行时模型切换：installModelSelection（packages/core/agent/src/model-selection.ts）通过 agent/request waterfall 在每次 LLM 调用时覆盖 provider/model，但不会回写 parent.options。用户通过 UI 切换模型后，父 Agent 实际使用新模型，但 parent.options 仍保存旧值。
依赖 agent-default-model 服务：某些代码路径（如 packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts:1148-1168 的 selectionFor 函数）在创建 Agent 时可能不设置 options.provider/options.model，而是依赖 agent/request waterfall 在运行时通过 agent-default-model 补全。这种情况下 parent.options 的 provider/model 可能为 undefined。
2. 配置层面：tool-subagent 未设置 agentOptions
文件：packages/bundle/base/cordis.patch.yml (第 313-325 行)

- id: tool-subagent
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
  config:
    provider: spawn
    toolName: subagent
    backgroundMode: continuable
    # 缺少 agentOptions，子 Agent 在 resolveChildAgentOptions 返回空时没有兜底

- id: tool-subagent-fork
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
  config:
    provider: fork
    toolName: subagent_fork
    backgroundMode: one-shot
    # 同样缺少 agentOptions

tool-subagent 的 Config 类型（packages/subagent/tool-subagent/src/index.ts:52）已经定义了 agentOptions?: AgentOptions 字段，execute 方法（第 381 行）也会将其透传到 startContinuable 或 start 请求中。但当前配置文件中没有设置该字段，导致子 Agent 无法获得模型配置。

此外，子 Agent 在创建时没有安装 installModelSelection（packages/core/agent/src/model-selection.ts），因此即使主 Agent 通过 agent/request waterfall 动态切换了模型，子 Agent 也没有这个兜底机制，而是完全依赖 resolveChildAgentOptions 返回的 agentOptions。

修复建议
1.resolveChildAgentOptions 增加 agentDefaultModel 兜底
在 resolveChildAgentOptions 中，当 parent.options.provider 或 parent.options.model 缺失时，通过 agentDefaultModel 服务获取当前默认值作为 fallback：

export function resolveChildAgentOptions(
  parent: Agent,
  requested: AgentOptions | undefined,
  childDepth: number,
): AgentOptions {
  const parentProvider = parent.options.provider
  const parentModel = parent.options.model
  const parentMaxTokens = parent.options.maxTokens

  // 如果父 Agent 没有显式设置 provider/model，尝试从 agent-default-model 服务读取
  let fallbackProvider = parentProvider
  let fallbackModel = parentModel
  if (fallbackProvider === undefined || fallbackModel === undefined) {
    try {
      const defaultModel = parent.ctx.get('agentDefaultModel')
      if (defaultModel !== undefined) {
        const selection = defaultModel.currentSelection()
        if (fallbackProvider === undefined) fallbackProvider = selection.provider
        if (fallbackModel === undefined) fallbackModel = selection.model
      }
    } catch {
      // agent-default-model 服务未安装，保持原行为
    }
  }

  return {
    ...fallbackProvider !== undefined ? { provider: fallbackProvider } : {},
    ...fallbackModel !== undefined ? { model: fallbackModel } : {},
    ...parentMaxTokens !== undefined ? { maxTokens: parentMaxTokens } : {},
    ...requested,
    subagentDepth: childDepth,
  }
}

2.在 base/cordis.patch.yml（或其他 bundle 配置）中，为 tool-subagent 和 tool-subagent-fork 添加 agentOptions：

- id: tool-subagent
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
  config:
    provider: spawn
    toolName: subagent
    backgroundMode: continuable
    agentOptions:
      provider: deepseek-api
      model: deepseek-v4-flash

- id: tool-subagent-fork
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
  config:
    provider: fork
    toolName: subagent_fork
    backgroundMode: one-shot
    agentOptions:
      provider: deepseek-api
      model: deepseek-v4-flash

注意：这里的 provider/model 应该是模板变量或者从 agent-default-model 的配置中读取，而不是硬编码。不同部署环境的默认模型可能不同。

records.title: [BUG]推理模型在仅支持 system role 的 OpenAI 兼容端点上请求失败
records.body:
使用 OpenAI Chat Completions 兼容接口时，为自定义模型开启 reasoning effort 后，DSH 会把 system prompt 以 `developer` role 发送。仅支持 `system`、`assistant`、`user` 和 `tool` 的供应商因此返回 400。

English summary: When reasoning is enabled for a custom OpenAI-compatible model, DSH sends the system prompt with the `developer` role. Providers that do not support this role reject the request. Reasoning effort and the system/developer role selection should be independently configurable.

<details>
<summary>复现、实际结果、预期结果与建议验收条件</summary>

## 复现

1. 配置一个使用 `openai-completions`（Chat Completions API）的自定义 OpenAI 兼容供应商。
2. 为模型配置 `reasoningEfforts`。
3. 选择一个 reasoning effort 并发送请求。

本次实测供应商为火山引擎 Ark。实际错误如下，请求 ID 已脱敏：

```text
# test from volcengine-ark
400: {"code":"InvalidParameter","message":"The parameter `messages.role` specified in the request are not valid: invalid value: `developer`, supported values are: `system`, `assistant`, `user`, `tool`. Request id: 021786*************","param":"","type":"BadRequest"}
```

## 实际结果

启用 reasoning effort 后，原本的 system prompt 被序列化为 `developer` role。供应商不支持该角色，请求在模型推理前直接失败。

## 预期结果

reasoning effort 与 system/developer role 的选择应能独立配置。对于不支持 `developer` role 的 OpenAI 兼容供应商，应能继续发送 `system` role，同时保留 `reasoning_effort`。

期望可以配置：

```yaml
compat:
  supportsDeveloperRole: false
```

上游 `@earendil-works/pi-ai` 已定义 `supportsDeveloperRole?: boolean`，但 DSH 当前的 `PiAiCompatProfile` 和配置 schema 只暴露 `thinkingFormat` 与 `supportsReasoningEffort`，因此无法从 DSH 配置传入该字段。

## 可能的影响范围

- `openai-completions`：已通过火山引擎 Ark 实际复现。
- `openai-responses`：尚未实际复现，但代码路径也会在 `model.reasoning` 为真且 `supportsDeveloperRole` 未设为 `false` 时选择 `developer` role，可能存在相同兼容性问题。

相关 DSH 代码：

- `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/catalog.ts`：`PiAiCompatProfile`、模型 reasoning 配置和 compat 转换。
- `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/config.ts`：compat 配置 schema。

## 环境

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai`: `0.1.0-rc.5`
- DeepSeek Harness commit: `47f943859b`
- Node.js: `v22.16.0`
- Provider: Volcengine Ark
- API mode: `openai-completions` / Chat Completions

## 建议验收条件

1. DSH 暴露并转发 `compat.supportsDeveloperRole: false`。
2. `openai-completions` 设置该选项后仍发送 `system` role，并继续发送所选 `reasoning_effort`。
3. 检查并支持 `openai-responses` 的同一选项；保留 `reasoning.effort`，同时发送 `system` role。
4. 未设置该选项时保持现有默认行为。
5. 为两种 API 模式分别添加覆盖测试。

</details>

records.title: [BUG]Expose `supportsDeveloperRole` (and sibling OpenAI-completions compat switches) in `llm-pi-ai`
records.body:
# Expose `supportsDeveloperRole` (and sibling OpenAI-completions compat switches) in `llm-pi-ai`



## Summary

A hand-declared (i.e. not in pi-ai's builtin catalog) **reasoning** model on a pi-ai
provider route cannot be made to work against gateways that don't accept the
`developer` role — such as Alibaba Cloud Model Studio's token-plan compatible-mode
endpoint — because the `llm-pi-ai` `compat` configuration surface only exposes
`thinkingFormat` and `supportsReasoningEffort`. The missing switches
(`supportsDeveloperRole`, `supportsStore`,
`requiresReasoningContentOnAssistantMessages`) are left to pi-ai's URL-based
auto-detection, which guesses wrong for unrecognized endpoints. This document
describes the failure, the root cause, and a small fix.

## Problem / reproduction

1. Configure a pi-ai provider route that has a builtin catalog but add a model id the
   catalog doesn't know yet, and give it reasoning efforts. Concrete example
   (`~/.dsh/settings.yaml`):

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    qwen-token-plan:
      apiKeyEnv: QWEN_TOKEN_PLAN_API_KEY
      models:
        # ...existing catalog models...
        - id: deepseek-v4-flash-0731
          name: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731
          contextWindow: 1000000
          maxTokens: 384000
          reasoningEfforts:
            off:
            high: high
            max: max
```

2. Select `deepseek-v4-flash-0731` and run a request. The endpoint answers:

```
400 {"error":{"code":"invalid_parameter_error","param":null,
  "message":"developer is not one of ['system', 'assistant', 'user', 'tool', 'function']",
  "type":"invalid_request_error"}, ...}
```

Notably, the *catalog* model `deepseek-v4-flash` on the same route works fine with
reasoning levels; only the hand-declared id fails.

## Root cause

The `developer` role is chosen by pi-ai in `convertMessages` (OpenAI Chat
Completions path):

```js
const useDeveloperRole = model.reasoning && compat.supportsDeveloperRole;
const role = useDeveloperRole ? "developer" : "system";
```

So a `developer` message is sent only when the model **reasons**
(`model.reasoning === true`) **and** `supportsDeveloperRole` is true.

- The builtin catalog entries for `qwen-token-plan` (and many other non-OpenAI
  gateways) explicitly set `"compat": { "supportsDeveloperRole": false, ... }`, so
  they serialize the system prompt as `system` and work.
- A hand-declared model has no catalog entry. pi-ai falls back to URL-based
  auto-detection, and for an unrecognized host like
  `token-plan.ap-southeast-1.maas.aliyuncs.com` it defaults to
  `supportsDeveloperRole: true` (the auto-detect logic only special-cases a handful
  of known hosts). So once `reasoningEfforts` makes the model a reasoning model, the
  system prompt is emitted as `developer` and the gateway rejects it.

The deeper issue is in dsh: `llm-pi-ai`'s `PiAiCompatProfile`
(`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/catalog.ts`) and its schema
(`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/config.ts`) only expose two compat switches:

```ts
export interface PiAiCompatProfile {
  thinkingFormat?: PiAiThinkingFormat
  supportsReasoningEffort?: boolean
}
```

`supportsDeveloperRole`, `supportsStore`, and
`requiresReasoningContentOnAssistantMessages` all exist on pi-ai's
`OpenAICompletionsCompat` type but are not configurable from dsh. This contradicts
the adapter's own documentation, which states that a route pi-ai has never heard of
is "fully describable from settings.yaml" — currently a hand-declared reasoning model
on a non-`developer` gateway cannot be described correctly.

## Proposed fix

Expose the three missing `OpenAICompletionsCompat` switches in `PiAiCompatProfile`,
the schemastery schema, and `resolveModelCompat`, with the same
route-level-default / per-model-override semantics already used by `thinkingFormat`
and `supportsReasoningEffort`:

```ts
export interface PiAiCompatProfile {
  thinkingFormat?: PiAiThinkingFormat
  supportsReasoningEffort?: boolean
  supportsDeveloperRole?: boolean
  supportsStore?: boolean
  requiresReasoningContentOnAssistantMessages?: boolean
}
```

```ts
const compatProfile: z<PiAiCompatProfile> = z.object({
  thinkingFormat: z.union(SUPPORTED_THINKING_FORMATS),
  supportsReasoningEffort: z.boolean(),
  supportsDeveloperRole: z.boolean(),
  supportsStore: z.boolean(),
  requiresReasoningContentOnAssistantMessages: z.boolean(),
})
```

and pass the three fields through in `resolveModelCompat` (reading `entry.compat`
then `route.compat`, exactly like the existing two fields).

After that, the working configuration is:

```yaml
        - id: deepseek-v4-flash-0731
          name: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731
          contextWindow: 1000000
          maxTokens: 384000
          reasoningEfforts:
            off:
            high: high
            max: max
          compat:
            thinkingFormat: deepseek
            supportsDeveloperRole: false
            supportsStore: false
            requiresReasoningContentOnAssistantMessages: true
```

- `supportsDeveloperRole: false` fixes the 400.
- `requiresReasoningContentOnAssistantMessages: true` is needed for multi-turn
  deepseek reasoning (assistant messages must echo an empty `reasoning_content`).
- `supportsStore: false` matches the catalog entries and avoids sending an
  unnecessary `store` field.

This has been verified to work locally.

## Scope question for maintainers

`OpenAICompletionsCompat` has several more fields beyond the two currently exposed
(`maxTokensField`, `supportsUsageInStreaming`, `requiresToolResultName`,
`requiresAssistantAfterToolResult`, `requiresThinkingAsText`, `supportsStrictMode`,
`cacheControlFormat`, etc.). Should this be:

1. a minimal fix exposing only the three fields needed to unblock hand-declared
   reasoning models (the approach above), or
2. a broader change exposing the full `OpenAICompletionsCompat` surface?

`maxTokensField` in particular is another common gateway need. Also note the web
Models editor (`ModelListEditor`) still only edits id/name/capacities, so these
switches remain `settings.yaml`-only for now — worth confirming whether a form field
is expected.

## Environment

- dsh `0.1.0-rc.5`
- `@earendil-works/pi-ai` `^0.82.1`
- Provider: `qwen-token-plan` (Alibaba Cloud Model Studio token-plan, compatible-mode
  `/v1`)

comments.body:
supportsDeveloperRole 应该暴露成可配置开关——和 #2007/#1498 是同一诉求，手写 provider 时开发者该能显式声明。

临时配置 compat.supportsDeveloperRole: false 可绕过，FAQ 有记录：https://github.com/Electricitysheep/dsh-handbook/blob/main/docs/faq.md

Confirmed at source level and implemented as a cherry-pick-ready branch.

## Patch: fix/pi-ai-compat-expose-role-store

https://github.com/zoahdev/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/pi-ai-compat-expose-role-store

- `PiAiCompatProfile`, the config schema, and `resolveModelCompat` now carry `supportsDeveloperRole`, `supportsStore`, and `requiresReasoningContentOnAssistantMessages` with the same precedence as the existing switches (model > route > catalog > pi-ai baseURL detection).
- Model-level switches on non-`openai-completions` protocols stay rejected; route-level switches still skip non-completions models on mixed routes.

## Verification

- `tsc -b tsconfig.host.json` - clean
- catalog.spec 53/53 including a new qwen-token-plan-style regression test (a hand-declared reasoning model receives the role/store/reasoning-content switches)

This also lands in the same file as our #1992 fix (id-level catalog modality inheritance), so the pi-ai configuration surface now covers both capability and endpoint-compat overrides for hand-declared models.

这里列出的 compat 丢失问题已经有一个可直接使用的绕路：[pi2dsh](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh) 让 Pi provider 插件以原生 DSH LLM route 注册，不经过手写 `llm-pi-ai` profile 的 compat 白名单。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh
dsh plugin --profile web add <对应网关的 Pi provider 包>
```

provider 自带 transport 时，它自己的完整模型描述和 `compat` 直接参与请求组装。线上录制验证了：`supportsDeveloperRole: false` 产生 `system` role；provider 的 `thinkingLevelMap` 变成 DSH 可选档位；用户选中的档位进入真实请求。

边界：这没有修复 DSH settings schema；它提供的是另一条进入同一个模型目录的 adapter 路线。

records.title: [Bug Report] Cannot switch to text‑only model in chat session with image history
records.body:
### Bug Report

#### Describe the bug
When a chat session contains image messages in history, switching to any text‑only model will immediately return an error and block switching.
Error message:
model‑unavailable: Model "deepseek‑v4‑pro" does not accept image input, but this session already contains images; select an image‑capable model.

This validation runs before sending request to LLM upstream.
**There is no yaml config option to bypass this check.** User cannot complete model switch within current chat window.

#### To Reproduce
1. Start new chat, select a vision‑capable model.
2. Upload an image and send message, now chat history contains image blocks.
3. Open model selector, switch to a text‑only model (does not support image input).
4. Observe error pops up, model switch failed.

#### Expected behavior
User should be allowed to switch, with explicit warning.
Current hard block forces user to create a brand‑new empty chat session, interrupting workflow.

Suggested fix:
When switching to text‑only model and session contains images:
1. Pop‑up confirmation dialog: warn user all image blocks will be stripped from history, only text remains.
2. After user confirm: remove all image payloads from message history and finish model switch.
3. Keep current blocking‑error as default safe behavior if user cancels.


Additional context
Safety goal should still be respected: avoid sending image blocks to text‑only model API. The confirmation ensures user is aware image history will be discarded.

Use‑case: After image analysis with vision model, user wants to continue text reasoning with fast text‑only model in same conversation.

---

### 中文描述
#### 问题现象
只要对话会话历史存在图片消息，切换纯文本模型直接报错阻断切换。
该校验发生在请求大模型接口之前，**当前版本没有任何配置项可以绕过该检查**，用户无法在原有对话窗口完成模型切换。

#### 复现步骤
1. 新建对话，选择支持图片的多模态模型
2. 上传一张图片发送消息，会话历史产生图片消息块
3. 模型选择器切换任意纯文本模型
4. 直接弹出报错，切换失败

#### 用户预期
希望可以允许切换，但给出明确提示。
现在强制用户必须新建空白对话，打断连续的对话流程。

#### 建议修复方案
检测到：会话包含图片 + 目标模型是纯文本模型
弹出确认弹窗，告知用户切换后会清除全部图片内容，仅保留文本消息；用户确认后自动剔除历史图片块，完成切换。
保留现有拦截报错逻辑作为取消时的行为，保证安全性，防止图片数据误传给不支持图片的上游API。

使用场景：先用多模态模型完成图片分析，希望在同一个对话继续用轻量纯文本模型做后续文字推理。

comments.body:
This exact image-history lock can be bypassed without modifying the append-only session log. [pi2dsh](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh) registers an image-admission companion for each text-only route.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh
```

Instead of selecting the original `deepseek-v4-pro` row, select the same model under **DeepSeek + Vision Bridge**. The companion declares image admission, so `session.selectModel` accepts the existing image history; before the original text-only adapter is called, it recursively replaces image blocks, including images nested in tool results, with text notices. Materialized attachments keep a local path in the notice.

With `@kassing/pi-vision` installed, the image evidence is analyzed and injected first. This path was verified on a real DSH Web image session; details are in `examples/vision-bridge`.

records.title: 建议为 compat 增加 supportsDeveloperRole 开关，并澄清切换协议后如何配置思考强度
records.body:
## 背景

部分自托管 / 企业网关是通用 OpenAI Chat Completions 兼容实现（如基于 Rust 的代理），只接受 `system/user/assistant/tool/latest_reminder` 角色，**不认 OpenAI 较新引入的 `developer` 角色**。当 `compat` 里配置了推理相关开关（如 `supportsReasoningEffort: true` + `reasoning: high`），且模型声明了 `reasoningEfforts` 时，DSH 会以 `role: "developer"` 发送系统提示，这类网关直接返回 400：

```
messages[0].role: unknown variant `developer`, expected one of `system`, `user`, `assistant`, `tool`, `latest_reminder`
```

## 根因（已读源码确认）

- `pi-ai/dist/api/openai-completions.js:787`：`const useDeveloperRole = model.reasoning && compat.supportsDeveloperRole;`
- `detectCompat`（同文件 :1148）：对通用端点 `isNonStandard=false` → 默认探测 `supportsDeveloperRole = true`。
- 但 `supportsDeveloperRole` **不是合法配置项**：`dsh-llm-pi-ai/lib/index.js:1333` 的 `compatProfile` schema 只声明 `thinkingFormat` 与 `supportsReasoningEffort` 两个键；且 `resolveModelCompat`（:1068）只把这两个键搬进 `model.compat`，其它键一律丢弃。
- 结果：`model.compat.supportsDeveloperRole` 永远读到 `undefined` → 回退探测值 `true` → 必发 `developer` 角色，且用户在 settings 里无法关闭它。

## 建议

在 `compat` 增加用户可覆盖的 `supportsDeveloperRole` 布尔开关，让不兼容的后端能强制用 `system` 角色：

1. `dsh-llm-pi-ai/lib/index.js` 的 `compatProfile` 增加字段：

```js
const compatProfile = z.object({
  thinkingFormat: z.union(SUPPORTED_THINKING_FORMATS),
  supportsReasoningEffort: z.boolean(),
  supportsDeveloperRole: z.boolean()   // 新增
});
```

2. `resolveModelCompat` 转发该键（与 `thinkingFormat`/`supportsReasoningEffort` 同处理）：

```js
return { compat: {
  ...base?.api === api ? base.compat : void 0,
  ...thinkingFormat === void 0 ? {} : { thinkingFormat },
  ...supportsReasoningEffort === void 0 ? {} : { supportsReasoningEffort },
  ...supportsDeveloperRole === void 0 ? {} : { supportsDeveloperRole }   // 新增
} };
```

3. `pi-ai` 的 `getCompat`（openai-completions.js:1194）已是 `model.compat.supportsDeveloperRole ?? detected`，无需改动。

预期：默认行为不变（仍按探测值），仅当用户显式写 `compat.supportsDeveloperRole: false` 时强制 `system` 角色。

comments.body:
你对根因的分析是对的：`supportsDeveloperRole` 在当前 DSH 手写 profile 路径里没有配置位置，所以换一种 YAML 写法也解决不了。

现成绕法是用 [pi2dsh](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh) 装网关对应的 Pi provider 包。自带 transport 的 provider 会注册成 DSH 原生 route，它的 `compat` 与 `thinkingLevelMap` 由自己的 adapter 消费：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh
dsh plugin --profile web add <Pi provider 包>
```

真实模型选择器和线上请求体都已验证：provider 声明的推理档位会出现在选择器，选中的值进入 stream；`supportsDeveloperRole: false` 会让 system prompt 以 `system` 发送。

这是绕过 settings 丢字段的 route，不是宣称上游 schema 已修。

records.title: [Bug] llm-pi-ai: hand-declared routes cannot disable the OpenAI "developer" system-prompt role — reasoning requests 400 on gateways that only accept "system" (e.g. Alibaba Cloud Model Studio / 阿里云百炼)
records.body:
## 现象 / Symptom

在 `settings.yaml` 里手声明一个 OpenAI 兼容网关路由（`api: openai-completions`），并给模型声明 `reasoningEfforts`（思考强度）后，所有请求以 400 失败：

```
invalid_parameter_error: developer is not one of ['system', 'assistant', 'user', 'tool', 'function']
```

具体场景：阿里云百炼（Model Studio）MaaS 专属部署 `https://ws-*.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1`，模型 `deepseek-v4-flash-0731` / `deepseek-v4-pro-0813`，带 `reasoningEfforts: { off: null, high: high, max: max }`。

## 根因 / Root cause

1. pi-ai 的 `convertMessages`（openai-completions）里：`const useDeveloperRole = model.reasoning && compat.supportsDeveloperRole` —— 模型一旦声明了推理能力（`model.reasoning = true`），system 提示词就以 OpenAI 的 `role: "developer"` 发送。
2. `detectCompat` 对未知网关（`ws-*.maas.aliyuncs.com` 不在任何已知名单里）默认 `supportsDeveloperRole: true`。
3. **DSH 的 `PiAiCompatProfile` 只暴露了 `thinkingFormat` 和 `supportsReasoningEffort`，没有暴露 `supportsDeveloperRole`**，因此配置层无法关闭它 —— 手声明路由无法复刻内置 provider 的此开关。

## 证据 / Evidence

**直接探测网关**（相同请求，仅 role 不同）：

| role | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `developer` | 400 `developer is not one of [...]` |
| `system` | 200 正常返回（含 `reasoning_content`） |

**上游已知此行为**：pi-ai 内置的 `qwen-token-plan-cn` provider（同为 `*.maas.aliyuncs.com` 域名）在模型数据里显式设置了 `compat.supportsDeveloperRole: false`，说明阿里云 MaaS 网关只接受 `system` 角色，且上游已在内置目录中处理。手声明路由缺这个开关，无法做同样的处理。

## 建议修复 / Suggested fix

给 `PiAiCompatProfile`（`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/catalog.ts` + `config.ts` schema）增加 `supportsDeveloperRole?: boolean` 并在 `resolveModelCompat` 透传给 pi-ai。已在本地验证可行：

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    alibaba:
      api: openai-completions
      baseURL: https://ws-xxx.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1
      compat:
        supportsReasoningEffort: true
        supportsDeveloperRole: false   # 网关只接受 system 角色
```

## 临时绕法 / Workaround

不给模型声明 `reasoningEfforts`（回到无思考强度状态），或等官方补上该开关。

---
环境：pi-ai 0.82.1，DSH 当前 master。

replies.body: 百炼的问题现在修复了吗

@zgxkbtl 修了，刚刚用百炼中国区 **Token Plan** 的真实订阅 key 跑穿了完整链路，不只是 `/v1/models` 探活：动态模型目录 → `alibaba-token-cn / deepseek-v4-pro` → DSH 原生 agent loop → 工具调用 → 工具结果回传 → 第二次模型请求 → 最终回答；重启后也复跑通过。

records.title: 自定义 OpenAI 兼容服务商无法使用 DeepSeek 思考强度：supportsDeveloperRole 被丢弃且 UI 缺少档位控件
records.body:
## 环境

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.6
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` 0.1.0-rc.6
- `@earendil-works/pi-ai` 0.82.1
- 上游：自建 / 公司的 OpenAI 兼容网关 → DeepSeek 官方 API

## 两个问题

### 1. 自定义服务商在 UI 上没有任何思考强度（reasoning effort）控件

“自定义服务提供商”卡片和编辑器刻意不提供推理档位字段，只能手工编辑 `settings.yaml`，给每个模型写 `reasoningEfforts` 和 `compat.thinkingFormat: deepseek`。对于把公司 DeepSeek 网关配成自定义服务商的用户，表现就是“无法选择思考强度”。

### 2. 即使按上述方式写好了配置，请求也会报 400

```
messages[0].role: unknown variant `developer`, expected one of
`system`, `user`, `assistant`, `tool`, `latest_reminder`
```

配置示例：

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    company-gateway:
      api: openai-completions
      baseURL: https://gateway.example.com/v1
      compat:
        thinkingFormat: deepseek
        supportsReasoningEffort: true
        supportsDeveloperRole: false   # DeepSeek 不接受 developer 角色
      models:
        - id: deepseek-v4-pro
          contextWindow: 1000000
          maxTokens: 128000
          reasoningEfforts:
            low: low
            high: high
            max: max
```

根因：pi-ai 在 `model.reasoning && compat.supportsDeveloperRole` 为真时，把 system prompt 序列化成 `developer` 角色（OpenAI o1/gpt-5 风格）。对非标准 baseURL，pi-ai 的自动检测会把 `supportsDeveloperRole` 默认成 `true`（只有 `*.deepseek.com` 的 URL 才会走 DeepSeek 专用检测），而 DeepSeek 的 OpenAI 兼容接口只接受 `system`，不接受 `developer`。

但 settings.yaml 里写 `compat.supportsDeveloperRole: false` **不会生效**，因为 `dsh-llm-pi-ai` 在三个位置把它丢弃了：

- `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/catalog.ts` 的 `PiAiCompatProfile` 只声明了 `thinkingFormat` / `supportsReasoningEffort`；
- `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/config.ts` 的 `compatProfile` schema 只校验这两个字段；
- `resolveModelCompat` 只把这两个字段透传给模型。

## 复现与验证

按上面的配置（包含 `supportsDeveloperRole: false`）抓包，发往上游的请求体仍然是 `"role":"developer"` → 400。本地给 schema 加上字段、并让 `resolveModelCompat` 透传后，同样请求变成 `"role":"system"` → 200，响应正常带 `reasoning_content`。

## 建议修复

1. 在 `PiAiCompatProfile`、`compatProfile` schema 和 `resolveModelCompat` 透传中增加 `supportsDeveloperRole?: boolean`。
2. 当配置 `compat.thinkingFormat: "deepseek"` 时，把 `supportsDeveloperRole` 默认设为 `false`（DeepSeek 协议永远不接受 `developer` 角色）。
3. 在自定义服务商编辑器的 UI 里暴露每个模型的 `reasoningEfforts` / `compat` 配置，避免必须手改 `settings.yaml`。

comments.body:
这里两个缺口可以一起绕过，但不是继续手写同一段 settings。做法是让网关对应的 Pi provider package 经 [pi2dsh](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh) 注册原生 route：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh
dsh plugin --profile web add <Pi provider 包>
```

自带 transport 的 provider 会把自己的 `thinkingLevelMap` 暴露成 DSH 推理档位，并在用户选择后把 effort 传给 stream；它模型描述上的 `supportsDeveloperRole: false` 同样直接参与请求组装，不经过 `PiAiCompatProfile` 白名单。

我们在真实 DSH 选择器和透传请求体上都验过：档位出现、选择值下传、首条 role 为 `system`。这条方案不会修改原 settings 路径，原 schema 问题仍需上游修。

records.title: 🐛 Bug: 会话内切换模型后，子 Agent 仍使用创建时的全局默认模型
records.body:
### 现象
在 GUI 会话中通过模型选择器把当前会话模型切换到「千问3.8」（provider `qwen-local`）后：
- 编排器（父 Agent）自身的请求确实使用千问 ✓
- 但该会话通过 `subagent` / `subagent_fork` 派生的子 Agent **仍然使用会话创建时的全局默认模型**（`deepseek-official / deepseek-v4-flash`）✗

期望：子 Agent 继承父 Agent **当前生效**的模型，除非显式指定（如 preset 的 `agentOptions`）。

### 复现
1. 配置两个 provider，全局默认模型为 A。
2. 新建会话（父 Agent 以 A 创建）。
3. 会话内切换到模型 B。
4. 父 Agent 发消息确认使用 B，然后调用 `subagent` 派生子 Agent → 子 Agent 实际使用 A。

### 根因
两套机制脱节：
- 子 Agent 继承链存在：`packages/subagent/subagent/src/child-agent.ts` 的 `resolveChildAgentOptions()` 与 `continuation.ts`（约 413 行）都以 `parent.options.provider/model` 为继承源。
- 但会话内切换模型走 `installModelSelection`（`packages/core/agent/src/model-selection.ts`），只挂钩 `system-prompt/assemble` 与 `agent/request`，**从不回写 `agent.options`**；而创建 Agent 时（`packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts` 约 1112 行）一律用全局默认 `agentOptions()`。
- 结论：继承源是「创建时选项」而非「当前生效选项」，会话切换对子 Agent 不生效。

### 已修复（附补丁）
修改：子代理模型解析优先读父会话最近一次实际请求的模型（`parent.session.requestHeader()?.config`，即 harness 自身认可的"当前生效模型"来源，apiproxy 1163 行同源），回退到创建时选项；显式 `agentOptions` 仍优先。
- 文件：`child-agent.ts`（新增 `parentModelRoute`）、`continuation.ts`（续跑路径）、测试 `continuation.spec.ts`
- 测试：continuation.spec 98/98 通过（含新增回归测试）
- 补丁：见附件 / 可联系获取（commit `f892329`，分支 `fix/subagent-model-inheritance`，已推送至 fork `delaydai/deepseek-harness`）

若团队认为方向正确，可直接应用该补丁；也欢迎指正更合适的实现位置（例如让 `installModelSelection` 同步回写 `agent.options`，或把 `ModelSelectionRef` 暴露给 subagent 解析路径）。

### 影响
任何"会话内切换模型后派生子 Agent"的用法都会静默使用旧模型（子 Agent 会话不显示模型，不易察觉）。对多模型部署（本地 Qwen + 云端 DeepSeek 混用）影响明显。

### 临时规避（部署侧）
在 preset 的 `tool-subagent` / `tool-subagent-fork` 配置 `agentOptions: { provider, model }` 固定子 Agent 模型。

comments.body:
这个问题现在有一条已经在 stock DSH + 真模型上跑通的替代路线。先说明边界：这不是修改 DSH 原生 `subagent/subagent_fork`，而是让 Pi 社区的 `@tintinweb/pi-subagents` 通过 pi2dsh 创建原生 DSH 子会话：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的-profile> add pi2dsh
dsh plugin --profile <你的-profile> add @tintinweb/pi-subagents
```

这条路线的继承顺序是：子代理显式模型 → 父会话持久日志最后一条真实 `request/header` 路由 → 创建时快照兜底。刚做的真机 E2E 和本帖复现同形状：父会话先走 `deepseek-official`，随后在 TUI 用 `/model` 切到独立 `work-gw/deepseek-chat`，再 spawn 一个不指定模型的子代理；持久日志断言父请求为 `official → work-gw`，子请求只出现 `work-gw`，且子代理真实执行工具写入 marker。

所以需要立即使用时，不必重启，也不需要给每个子代理写死 route；它会跟随父会话已经实际使用的当前 provider/model。完整可复现装置与证据：
https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/tree/main/examples/subagents
https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/blob/main/community/subagents-acceptance-report.md

deepseek-harness 已支持通过 cordis.patch.yml 的 insert 块挂载 MCP 服务器（如 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client），工具会以 mcp__<serverName>__<toolName> 的形式注册到模型工具列表。但官方文档缺少具体配置示例，新用户不知道如何接入。

- insert:

records.title: Proposal: opt-in image export to text for text-only model sessions
records.body:
## Problem

When a browser prompt carries image parts but the current session model reports no `image` input modality, the gateway rejects the turn with `MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES`. That forces every text-only session to abandon GUI image attachments, even when a vision tool (local OCR, screenshot diff, image Q&A) could consume the image by file path.

Recurring pain point for users who:
- Run a text-only model as the primary agent but occasionally paste screenshots.
- Pair a text-only agent with a local vision toolkit (e.g. `dsh-vision-toolkit`) that reads images by file path.
- Want the Web UI to stay usable for images without switching to a multimodal model.

Today the only workaround is a binary patch against `dsh-host-apiproxy` that injects an `exportImagePartsToText` helper into the `admit()` closure — fragile, lost on every upgrade, and impossible to ship as a plugin because `admit` is a private closure with no event seam (it runs before `agent/request`, `durablePromptContent`, and `agent.followup`).

## Proposal

Add an **opt-in** fallback at the same boundary. When `imageExportOnTextOnly` is enabled and the current model is text-only, the gateway materializes each image part into the session workspace (under `imageExportDir`, default `.dsh-attachments`) and replaces it with a text block carrying the exported file path. The message stays text-only (the text-only adapter accepts it) and the agent can hand the path to a vision tool.

**Default `false` preserves the original reject behavior** — no change for existing deployments.

### Config (3 new fields on `ApiProxyService`)

| field | type | default | purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `imageExportOnTextOnly` | boolean | `false` | enable the fallback |
| `imageExportDir` | string | `.dsh-attachments` | directory under session cwd |
| `imageExportNotice` | string | `[Image attachment saved to ${path}; use a vision tool to read it]` | text block template; literal `${path}` replaced |

## Design notes

- **Validation mirrors `durablePromptContent`**: same `imageLimits` (count + aggregate bytes), same per-image `validateImage`, canonical base64 decode. No new attack surface.
- **File-name de-duplication**: a second image with the same name gets an index suffix (`dup.png` → `dup-1.png`) so exports never overwrite each other.
- **Missing session cwd**: raises `AttachmentError('INVALID_IMAGE')` rather than writing into an unknown location.
- **Notice text is configurable**: lets deployments localize or reword the instruction to the model.
- **No new event seam needed**: the fallback lives inside `admit()` next to the existing text-only check, so it sees the raw browser payload before any durable transformation. A plugin-only approach cannot reach this layer.
- **`MEDIA_TYPE_EXTENSIONS`** (already in `session-export.ts`) is now `export`ed and reused, avoiding a parallel media-type table.

## Why opt-in

Text-only rejection is correct default behavior — silently dropping images into the workspace could surprise users who expect a hard failure. The flag makes the trade-off explicit: a deployment that pairs text-only agents with a vision toolkit opts in; everyone else sees no change.

## Implementation

A reference implementation is on a fork branch (the repo does not accept external PRs per `CONTRIBUTING.md`, so sharing here for discussion):

https://github.com/kiligzzz/deepseek-harness/tree/feat/image-export-on-text-only

Diff: `packages/host/apiproxy/` — 5 files, +290/-14.

### Verification on that branch

- `tsc -b packages/host/apiproxy/tsconfig.json` — clean
- `oxlint packages/host/apiproxy` — 0 warnings, 0 errors
- `vitest run packages/host/apiproxy` — 377 passed (20 files), including 3 new tests:
  - default reject still fires when the flag is off
  - export writes files and emits path text blocks
  - repeated file names de-duplicate with an index suffix

## Out of scope

- This does not add a generic `prompt/admit` event. The fallback is intentionally narrow (text-only image export) and config-driven. A broader event seam is a separate design decision.
- File-part export (non-image attachments) is not touched; the existing `file` path in `admit` is unchanged.

Happy to rework the shape (e.g. a broader event, a different config namespace, or folding the notice into a system-prompt section instead) based on maintainer feedback.

comments.body:
这个 proposal 描述的行为已经有一个可安装实现：[pi2dsh](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh) 为 text-only route 注册单独的 image-admission companion，而不是修改原模型的能力声明。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh
```

选择器里的 `<route>-vision` 会接受图片、把附件物化成文件，并在发往原 text-only adapter 前移除像素块。安装了 `@kassing/pi-vision` 时，图像分析作为上下文注入；没有视觉插件时，替换文本会明确带上本地路径，任何 path-taking OCR/vision tool 都能接管。

这样原 route 仍然诚实地声明 text-only，只有 companion 声明图片准入。Web 真贴图闭环在 `examples/vision-bridge`。

FYI — this is exactly what my host-level plugin [dsh-visibridge](https://github.com/lhbsaa/dsh-visibridge) does today: a text-only model calls analyze_image (image path/URL) and gets structured evidence (full OCR text, layout regions, semantics, uncertainty) instead of an unusable image block. No adapter wrapping, no loop changes — just a tool registered on the host.

It also ships capture_image: the model can take a USB camera photo and read the actual result, which turns text-only debugging into a shoot-look-adjust visual loop (verified on phone-screen small-text OCR).

Happy to hear if your proposal prefers a different architecture (e.g. paste-to-path interception); the two approaches can coexist.
